kumani_cv.summary: Create your European-style CV: every PDF has a QR code leading to your always up-to-date public page.
kumani_cv.step1Text: Tap “New CV”. The CV is European-style and every PDF has a QR code leading to your public page: whoever scans it always sees the latest version.
kumani_cv.step2Text: Give the CV a name (for example “Italian CV”), choose the content language and one of the three templates: Minimal, Classic or Sidebar. Then add a photo and your details.
kumani_cv.step2Tip: You can create several CVs, for example one in Italian and one in English.
kumani_cv.step3Text: Fill in the sections with “Add experience”, “Add education”, skills, languages, certifications and links. With “Preview” you see right away how it looks.
kumani_cv.step4Text: Tap “Create CV”. Then you can download the PDF, copy the public link or share it via WhatsApp and email. If you update the CV, the link and QR always show the new version.

findo.title: Findo
findo.summary: Your personal inventory: record where you keep things and find them in a moment.
findo.step1Text: Record where you keep things (documents, tools, valuables) and find them in a moment. To start, tap “Add item”.
findo.step2Text: Add a photo, write what you’re recording, choose where it is (or create a new location), then category and tags. Tap “Save item”.
findo.step2Tip: Locations are reusable: “Bedroom wardrobe”, “Cellar”, “Office”… If you move an item, Findo keeps the history of where it’s been.
findo.step3Text: Search by name, tag or location, show favourites only, or open “Manage locations” to see what’s in each place.

life_calendar.title: Life Calendar
life_calendar.summary: Documents, car, home, contracts and subscriptions: all your deadlines in one place, with renewals and reminders.
life_calendar.step1Title: All your deadlines in one place
life_calendar.step1Text: At the top you see how many deadlines are on track, coming up, urgent or expired. Tap “New deadline” to add one.
life_calendar.step2Text: Write what you want to remember (ID card, car insurance, MOT…), choose the category and, if you like, a profile: a person, a car, a home. Then enter the due date.
life_calendar.step3Text: Choose whether it repeats (every month, every year, every 2 years…) and when to remind you, from 180 days to 1 day before. We remind you on the dashboard and in the MemoLife calendar.

memolife.title: MemoLife
memolife.summary: Your diary: appointments, reminders, notes and contacts, together with bills and deadlines.
memolife.step1Text: MemoLife brings together appointments, reminders, notes and contacts in the Today, Calendar, Reminders, Notes and Contacts tabs. The calendar also shows your Spendly bills and Life Calendar deadlines.
memolife.step2Text: Tap the “+” button at the bottom and choose appointment, reminder, note or contact. From here you can also add a bill (Spendly) or a document deadline (Life Calendar).

spendly.title: Spendly
spendly.summary: Your personal budget month by month: income, bills and expenses under control.
spendly.step1Text: In the “Annual Dashboard” you see the year’s income, fixed expenses, variable expenses and net balance, with the balance trend month by month.
spendly.step2Text: At the top you switch between tabs: Dashboard, Income, Bills, Fixed Expenses and Variable Expenses. In each one, tap “New” to add an entry.
spendly.step3Text: Choose a month to see its details: income, expenses, balance and variable expenses by category. The colours tell you whether the month is positive, on watch or critical.
spendly.step4Text: In the “Bills” tab add electricity, gas, water, phone… with “New bill”: they repeat automatically and you record what you actually paid. If you close a contract, deactivate it.

svat.title: SVAT – Anti-Fraud Check
svat.summary: Check in seconds whether a website, a VAT number or a QR code can be trusted.
svat.step1Text: You can check a website (“Website Check”), a VAT number (“VAT Number Check”) or a QR code (“QR Check”).
svat.step2Text: Enter the website address and tap “Run Verification”: in a few seconds you get a score from 0 to 100 and a verdict.
svat.step3Text: Below you see how many checks are OK, worth watching or risky: domain and DNS, security, content, legal pages, reviews and business model.
svat.step4Text: In the “VAT Number Check” tab enter an Italian or European VAT number to find out whether it’s active and who it belongs to.
svat.step4Tip: A good score is a clue, not a guarantee: before paying, also read the Anti-Scam Manual.

focus.title: KUMANI Focus
focus.summary: Work in intervals: focus and short breaks, with a long break every 4 sessions.
focus.step1Text: Write what you’re focusing on and tap “Start”: the countdown begins. You can skip a phase or start over; a soft sound tells you at every change.
focus.step2Text: Classic 25/5, Long 50/10, Short 15/3 or Custom. You can turn on sound, vibration, keep the screen on and get a notification at every change.
focus.step3Text: See how many sessions you completed and how many minutes you focused today. It resets every day and stays only on your device.
focus.step3Tip: Open “Tips for better focus” for a few suggestions.

mandala.title: KUMANI Mandala
mandala.summary: Draw with one finger: your stroke becomes a symmetrical mandala. No skill required.
mandala.step1Text: Draw a line on the canvas: it’s repeated symmetrically and becomes a mandala in seconds.
mandala.step2Text: Choose the symmetry (6, 8, 12 or 16 segments), a dark or ivory background, brush or eraser, thickness and colour. “Undo” takes a step back, “Clear” starts over.
mandala.step3Text: Tap “Download PNG” to save the drawing and share it, for example on WhatsApp.
mandala.step3Tip: To relax even more, you can listen to Neurobalance waves while you draw.

mosaic.title: KUMANI Mosaic
mosaic.summary: Every Kumano places a few tiles a day on a shared canvas: a work created by the whole community.
mosaic.step1Title: A work of the whole community
mosaic.step1Text: Every Kumano leaves their mark on the shared canvas: nobody owns it, everyone created it. You can zoom in, replay how it grew, share it and download it.
mosaic.step2Text: Every day you get a few tiles: tap a free square, choose a colour and confirm. A placed tile stays forever. Tiles renew at midnight and each season has a theme and an end date.
mosaic.step2Tip: You can place tiles after 7 days of logging in to KUMANI. If you also use another KUMANI service the same day, you get a bonus tile.
mosaic.step3Text: Unlock the season’s achievements: Co-founder of the artwork, Final tile and Mosaicist. If you see offensive writing or an ad, tap one of its tiles and report the area.

oxygen.title: OXYGEN
oxygen.summary: Three minutes to breathe again, with 4-7-8 breathing: breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 7, breathe out for 8.
oxygen.step1Text: Choose the guided session (about 3 minutes, with a few words along the way) or just breathe, and how many cycles: 4 are recommended. You can turn on sound and vibration to breathe with your eyes closed.
oxygen.step2Text: Sit or lie down somewhere quiet, never while driving. The first time do at most 4 cycles and, if you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally.
oxygen.step2Tip: OXYGEN is a relaxation exercise, not a medical device: it doesn’t replace a doctor’s advice.
oxygen.step3Text: Tap “Start breathing”: the circle grows and shrinks with you and guides you step by step.

fabula.title: Kumani Fabula
fabula.summary: Six dice, one story: write a micro-story with today’s dice and read the community’s.
fabula.step1Text: In “Today’s roll” the dice are the same for the whole community and change at midnight. With “Free roll” you can roll whenever you like.
fabula.step2Text: Tap “Roll the dice”: you get a character, place, object, emotion, action and atmosphere. Write a micro-story (up to 900 characters) that uses them all; if you like, try the 60-second challenge.
fabula.step3Text: Publish the story in the “Gallery” or keep it in “My stories”. Read how others told the same dice, in seven languages: no rankings, just applause.
fabula.step3Tip: Write every day to earn the “Steady pen” achievement.

neurobalance.title: Neurobalance
neurobalance.summary: Audio sessions with binaural frequencies and nature sounds, for a relaxing break.
neurobalance.step1Text: Put on stereo headphones, choose a session (for example “Deep rest”, “Fluid focus” or “Mindful reset”), adjust the volume and tap “Start session”.
neurobalance.step2Text: Carrier frequencies to listen to with stereo headphones, at a low, comfortable volume. Tap the play button next to the one you want.
neurobalance.step3Text: Rain, ocean, stream, forest, dawn birds, wind, fireplace, night and thunderstorm: turn one on and shape it with the mixer.
neurobalance.step3Tip: Neurobalance is meant for relaxation, it isn’t a therapy.

aureya.title: Aureya
aureya.summary: Three quick self-check tests, hearing, visual acuity and the Amsler grid, to repeat and compare over time.
aureya.step1Text: Aureya is a self-check tool, not a medical device, and doesn’t replace a check-up. Results depend on headphones, volume, screen, light and distance: they’re indicative.
aureya.step2Text: You hear a series of tones at different frequencies, one ear at a time, and tap “I hear it” as soon as you perceive them. Between sounds there’s a pause of silence of varying length: tap only when you really hear the sound.
aureya.step3Title: Visual acuity and the Amsler grid
aureya.step3Text: In the visual acuity test you say which way the letter “E” is facing as it gets smaller, with no time limit. In the Amsler grid you look at the dot in the centre and mark the areas where the lines look wavy, blurred or missing. Both are done one eye at a time.
aureya.step3Tip: The first time you measure the screen by placing a credit card on it: this shows the letter and grid at the right size.
aureya.step4Text: Each test saves the date and result in the “Test history”, so you can compare them over time.
aureya.step4Tip: If you notice a decline, wavy lines or missing areas, especially for the first time, see a doctor or an eye specialist.

travel.title: KUMANI Travel
travel.summary: The trip that organises itself: a day-by-day itinerary and checklist shared with your travel companions.
travel.step1Text: Tap “New trip”, add dates and activities: the itinerary builds day by day. In the checklist, note what not to forget and who’s taking care of it.
travel.step1Tip: Creating a trip requires a subscription; joining a trip you were invited to doesn’t.
travel.step2Title: Invite or join with a code
travel.step2Text: From the trip, tap “Invite to the trip” and send the link or code to your companions. If you received a code, enter it under “Got an invite code?” and tap “Join”.

fincheck.title: FinCheck
fincheck.summary: The financial-education quiz and your budget check-up: find out where your money goes and how to make ends meet.
fincheck.step1Text: Open FinCheck and tap “Start the quiz”: 15 simple questions about your money habits, about 3 minutes. The quiz is free.
fincheck.step2Text: One question at a time on awareness, saving, debt, spending and the future. Pick the answer closest to what you really do; tap “Back” to change it.
fincheck.step3Text: At the end you see your profile, your score out of 45 and a traffic light for each of the 5 areas, with a tip for the ones to improve.
fincheck.step3Tip: Your results are private: only you can see them.
fincheck.step4Text: If you use Spendly, FinCheck works out the average of the last 3 months: income, expenses, what you have left, the 50/30/20 rule and a traffic light for housing, loans, subscriptions and other indicators.
fincheck.step4Tip: The check-up is included from the Plus plan and works best with 3 months of income and expenses recorded in Spendly.
fincheck.step5Text: FinCheck suggests up to 3 concrete goals, with amounts based on your budget: tick them off when done. After 3 months, retake the quiz to see your progress.
fincheck.step5Tip: You get KU Karma for the quiz the first time and then every 3 months.

menu.title: KUMANI Menu
menu.summary: Your venue’s menu online, with a QR on the table and in several languages.
menu.step1Text: Create the menu with your venue’s name, style and languages. In the “Your online menu” tab you’ll find the link, the QR to download, the menu as a PDF and the card to put on the table.
menu.step1Tip: With “Settings” you change the style, languages and review link.
menu.step2Text: Tap “Add category” (for example Starters), then “Add dish” in each category. Use the arrows to change the order and “Available” to mark a dish as sold out.
menu.step3Text: Enter the name, price, photo and description in each language, then choose the features (vegan, gluten-free…) and the allergens. You can also mark it as “Dish of the day”.
menu.step3Tip: “Translate with AI” fills in the missing translations in one click.
menu.step4Title: The menu as the customer sees it
menu.step4Text: The customer scans the QR and sees the menu in their language, with the dish of the day highlighted and the allergens for each dish.

fidelity.title: Kumi Card
fidelity.summary: The digital loyalty card: stamps on the customer’s phone, the reward and the stats.
fidelity.step1Text: Create the card with your business name, the reward and the number of stamps, then tap “Open till mode” on the phone or tablet you keep at the till.
fidelity.step1Tip: On other devices the till unlocks with the PIN you choose.
fidelity.step2Text: In till mode choose how many stamps to give and tap “Give stamp”: a QR appears for the customer to scan with their phone. This is also where you hand over the reward.
fidelity.step3Text: The customer sees the stamps collected, the reward and how many stamps are left, without downloading any app. At the till they can also show their code.
fidelity.step4Text: On your page you see stamps per week and the busiest days and times, plus customers, rewards given and the average return rate.
fidelity.step5Text: In “Your customers” you find who is close to the reward and, if they gave consent, you contact them with “Write on WhatsApp” to bring them back.

preventivi.title: Quotes
preventivi.summary: Professional quotes with your letterhead, as a PDF, to send on WhatsApp or by email.
preventivi.step1Text: The first time, fill in the Company Profile with your logo, company name, VAT number and contacts: they appear at the top of every quote.
preventivi.step2Text: Tap “New quote” and enter the customer’s details, or pick a customer you’ve already saved.
preventivi.step3Text: In “Quote items” write the description, quantity and price; with “Add item” you add more. The total is calculated automatically.
preventivi.step3Tip: Also add the payment method and notes: they appear in the PDF.
preventivi.step4Text: After “Create quote” you see the summary with the customer, the items, the total and the validity dates.
preventivi.step5Text: Tap “Download PDF” and send it to the customer on WhatsApp or by email. With “Edit” you can change it whenever you like.

digital_receipt.title: Digital Receipts
digital_receipt.summary: A digital receipt for every delivery or loan, confirmed by the recipient.
digital_receipt.step1Text: Here you find all your receipts with their status: Pending, Confirmed or Returned. Tap “New receipt” to create one.
digital_receipt.step2Title: Choose the type and fill in
digital_receipt.step2Text: Choose the type (delivery, loan, keys, documents…), add a photo if you like and write the item, recipient and date. Then tap “Create receipt”.
digital_receipt.step2Tip: For a loan you can set the return date and get a reminder.
digital_receipt.step3Text: Copy the link or let the recipient scan the QR. You can also download the PDF; when the loan ends, tap “Confirm return”.
digital_receipt.step4Text: The recipient opens the link, with no account needed, and taps “I confirm I received the above”. The receipt becomes “Confirmed”.

magazzino.title: Magazzino PRO
magazzino.summary: Products, stock levels, stock in and out and reorder alerts in one place.
magazzino.step1Text: At the top you see the stock value, products below minimum stock, this month’s movements and the average margin.
magazzino.step2Text: Tap “New product” and enter the name, category, unit of measure, cost, selling price, minimum stock and opening stock.
magazzino.step2Tip: With “Scan code” you find a product by scanning its barcode.
magazzino.step3Text: On each product use the stock in, stock out or stocktake buttons: choose the reason and quantity and save. The stock level updates automatically.
magazzino.step4Text: In the “Dashboard” you find the stock value, the products to reorder and the most moved ones. From “Products” and “Movements” you export everything as CSV for your accountant.

qr_code_pro.title: QR Code PRO
qr_code_pro.summary: Dynamic QR codes: change the destination whenever you like and count the scans.
qr_code_pro.step1Text: Here you find all your QR codes with the number of scans. Tap “New QR Code” to create one.
qr_code_pro.step2Text: Give the QR a name and choose what it should do: open a website, write on WhatsApp, call, send an SMS or an email, connect to WiFi or save a contact. Then choose the colours and tap “Create QR Code”.
qr_code_pro.step3Title: Download and change whenever you like
qr_code_pro.step3Text: In the details you see the scans, copy the dynamic link and download the QR. If you change the destination, the QR you’ve already printed keeps working.
qr_code_pro.step3Tip: Print the QR on flyers and business cards: you’ll never need to reprint them.

firma_email.title: Email Signature
firma_email.summary: A professional email signature with your details, your socials and the link to your Link in Bio.
firma_email.step1Text: Choose between Classic, Compact and Modern.
firma_email.step2Text: Write your name, role and company, then your contacts: phone, mobile, email, website and address.
firma_email.step2Tip: The draft stays saved on this device.
firma_email.step3Text: Choose your brand colour and paste the links to your social profiles. You can also add the link to your Link in Bio.
firma_email.step4Text: Check the preview and tap “Copy signature”. You can also copy the HTML code or download the file.
firma_email.step5Text: In “How to add the signature” you find the steps for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and iPhone.

calcolatrici.title: PRO Calculators
calcolatrici.summary: VAT, discounts, markup and margin, withholding tax: everyday sums in a moment.
calcolatrici.step1Text: In the “VAT” tab choose whether to add or remove VAT, enter the amount and the rate: you immediately see the net amount, the VAT and the total.
calcolatrici.step2Text: In the “Discount” tab enter the price and the discount as a percentage, in euros or stacked: you see the final price and the saving.
calcolatrici.step3Text: Enter the cost and selling price to see markup, margin and profit, or work out the price starting from the margin or markup you want.
calcolatrici.step4Text: From the fee you work out the net amount to pay and the invoice total, with pension contribution and VAT, or start from the net amount you want to receive.
calcolatrici.step4Tip: Copy the result with “Copy result”. The calculation is indicative: always check with your accountant.

landing_page.title: Landing Page
landing_page.summary: Your business website on kumani.io: copy written with AI, colours of your choice, contact details and a QR code to share.
landing_page.step1Text: Open “Write the copy with AI” and answer the questions: what you do, where, for whom and which services you offer. Tap “Write the draft”: the AI prepares the introduction, services, about me, method and the description for Google.
landing_page.step1Tip: The AI only uses what you write: always reread the draft before publishing.
landing_page.step2Text: In “Address and language” choose the page address (kumani.io/page/…) and the language you write in. In “Style” choose between Elegant dark, Light and Colourful, and pick the main colour.
landing_page.step3Text: In “Introduction” add your name, headline, photo, logo and the main button (WhatsApp, call, email or link). In “Page blocks” make the ones you need visible, fill them in and change their order with the arrows.
landing_page.step3Tip: In Testimonials only publish genuine quotes from real customers, with their consent.
landing_page.step4Text: Tick “Publish the page” and tap “Save”. At the top you’ll find your address with “Copy”, “Open” and “Download QR”, ready for business cards, your shop window and social media.
landing_page.step4Tip: In “Business details” enter your company name and VAT number, if you have one.
landing_page.step5Title: The page as customers see it
landing_page.step5Text: Anyone who opens the link sees your page on their phone or computer and can contact you with one tap, including through the “Message me” form: messages arrive in the “Messages” tab, on your dashboard and as a notification on your phone.

garage.title: Kumani Garage
garage.summary: Cars and motorbikes in one place: lease mileage tracking, deadlines with reminders, documents always with you and expenses that also go into Spendly.
garage.step1Text: Tap «Add vehicle», choose car or motorbike and whether it is owned or leased. Enter a name, make and model and, if you like, the number plate.
garage.step2Text: For a long-term lease enter pickup date, duration in months, included km and monthly payment. With the cost per extra km we also tell you how much you might pay at the end of the contract.
garage.step2Tip: Tick «Also add the monthly payment to Spendly fixed expenses» to find it in your monthly budget.
garage.step3Title: Update the mileage and check the budget
garage.step3Text: Every now and then enter the current km with the date: you instantly see if you are within budget, how many km per day you can still drive and the end-of-contract projection.
garage.step4Text: Add road tax, insurance, inspection and service: they appear in the Home agenda and we remind you ahead of time. When you pay, tap «Paid»: it becomes a vehicle expense, also in Spendly.
garage.step5Text: In the «Documents» section upload a photo or PDF of the registration, the insurance and other documents, front and back too: only you can see them and you also find them in Documents.

casa.title: KUMANI Casa
casa.summary: Your whole home in one place: maintenance and deadlines with reminders, utilities linked to your Spendly bills, appliances with their warranty and your home documents.
casa.step1Text: Tap “Add home”, enter a name and, if you like, the address. You can have up to 3 homes: main home, second home or rented out. Each card shows the next deadline and the warranties about to end.
casa.step2Text: In “Deadlines” tap “Add deadline” and pick a ready-made maintenance task (boiler, air conditioner filters, smoke detectors…): the title and how often it repeats are filled in, you only choose the date. When it is done, tap “Done” and it moves to the next time.
casa.step2Tip: Home deadlines also appear in Life Calendar and in the Home agenda, and with notifications on we remind you 30, 7 and 1 day before.
casa.step3Text: In “Utilities” add electricity, gas, water and the others: provider, customer number, supply point code and the fault line, which you call with one tap. With the offer end date we remind you to check the price.
casa.step3Tip: Link the bill you already have in Spendly or create it from here: it stays in Spendly’s fixed expenses, where you mark it paid with the real amount.
casa.step4Text: In “Appliances” add the washing machine, fridge, boiler…: brand, model, room, purchase date, a photo of the receipt and the manual. You see right away how long they are under warranty, and we remind you before it ends.
casa.step5Text: In “Documents” upload the contract, insurance policy, system certificates, energy certificate and floor plan, as a PDF or a photo: only you can see them. If a document expires, enter the date and we remind you to renew it. You also find them in Documents → My docs.

sorprese.title: KUMANI Surprise
sorprese.summary: Give an experience with a gift voucher or a surprise journey that unfolds day by day: create it for free, activate it by card or with your points and send it with a link.
sorprese.step1Text: In the Wallet tap “Create a surprise”, or open kumani.io/sorprese. Pick a ready-made template (mum, anniversary, birthday, thank you) or tap “Create a surprise” to start from scratch. Then choose the type: gift voucher, 3-day or 7-day journey.
sorprese.step1Tip: Creating and trying out the surprise is free: you only pay when you activate it to send it.
sorprese.step2Text: Write who it’s for, who it’s from and your message. Choose the occasion (birthday, love, Christmas…): icon, colours and opening effect adapt by themselves. You can pick one of 10 colours, how it opens (box, envelope with a letter, scratch to reveal) and background music or your own audio.
sorprese.step3Text: In journeys you add the steps for each day: a message, a gallery of up to 6 photos, a riddle with its answer, a place with a map or a song. You can attach photos, videos or a voice message recorded on your phone: they are compressed automatically and stay under 10 MB.
sorprese.step3Tip: Tap “Preview” to see the surprise as the recipient will, opening included.
sorprese.step4Title: Activate it by card or with points
sorprese.step4Text: When it’s ready, at the bottom of the page activate it by card or with your points: KU Karma or confirmed KU Points. As soon as it’s active you get the link to send on WhatsApp, by email or however you like.
sorprese.step4Tip: Below the payment button you can see how many points are needed and how many you have: if they’re not enough, the button stays grey.
sorprese.step5Text: When the recipient opens the gift you know right away, and they can reply with a reaction, a message or a photo: you’ll find it with the pink envelope in “My surprises” and in a box as soon as you open your dashboard. Drafts you no longer need can be deleted with the bin; surprises already paid for stay.

nexus.title: KUMANI Nexus
nexus.summary: The daily crossword and the Challenge with friends: a new grid every day and games for 2 to 4 players.
nexus.step1Text: Every day there is a new grid, the same for everyone, in Italian or English (choose at the top). You can see how many words there are: the timer only starts when you tap “Start”.
nexus.step2Title: Choose a word and type it
nexus.step2Text: Tap a square to choose the word; tap it again to switch between across and down, or use the arrows next to the clue. Type with the keyboard at the bottom: you can type the whole word, letters that are already right are skipped.
nexus.step3Text: When a word is complete we check it: if it is right it turns green and stays in place, if it is wrong the clue bar turns red. Stuck? The light bulb reveals the letter in the chosen square.
nexus.step3Tip: Hints used are shown in your result, but the grid still counts for your streak.
nexus.step4Text: When the grid is done you see your time, your streak and the hints used, and you earn KU Karma. “Share your result” creates an image with the shape of the grid, without giving away the words.
nexus.step5Text: With “Challenge friends” you create a game and send the code on WhatsApp: friends join from the link, even without signing up. When there are 2 to 4 of you, tap “Start the game”. In turn you choose a word and tap “Try”: each right word takes your colour and is worth 1 point per letter, +3 for each crossing and double on the ×2 square.
nexus.step5Tip: Anyone who lets two turns in a row run out leaves the game. Until someone joins, you can cancel the challenge.

clienti.title: Clients & Jobs
clienti.summary: Clients, jobs, time, margin and payments in one place, linked to your Quotes.
clienti.step1Text: At the top you’ll find “Today”: what you have to collect, who to contact (with “Call” and “Done”), delivered jobs not yet paid and what starts or is due today.
clienti.step1Tip: On a delivered, unpaid job, “WhatsApp reminder” opens a ready-written message for the client.
clienti.step2Text: In the list you search by name, city or phone and filter “To contact” or “Owe you”. Add a client with “New client” or import them from Kumi Card and MemoLife contacts.
clienti.step2Tip: Every saved quote and every paid Shop order adds or updates its client automatically.
clienti.step3Text: From the card you call, message on WhatsApp or send an email with one tap. You see what’s agreed, what you’ve collected and what’s still owed, and set the “Next step” with a date.
clienti.step4Text: With “New job” you create a job, also from an accepted quote. On its page you change the status (To start, In progress, Delivered, Paid) and tick off the things to do.
clienti.step5Text: Start the timer while you work: it keeps running even if you close the page. Set the hourly cost and add materials and expenses, also from Magazzino PRO: “Job margin” tells you what you keep.
clienti.step5Tip: On the same page you upload site photos and documents: they stay private.
clienti.step6Text: Record payments received in cash, by bank transfer or card: the client’s accounts update. From a payment you make the digital receipt already filled in.
clienti.step6Tip: At the bottom of the client list you download clients, jobs, payments and hours as Excel files (CSV) for your accountant.

brand.title: Your brand colors
brand.summary: Four colors chosen once and used by Landing Page, Quotes, QR Code PRO, Link in Bio and Email signature.
brand.step1Text: Open your Business profile from the menu at the top right and, in the colors section, tap “Choose brand colors”. It works with the Plus and Pro plans.
brand.step2Text: Start “From logo” (colors are read from your Business profile logo, right on your phone), from “Generate” with a combination, or “By hand”. Assign the four roles: primary, accent, background and text.
brand.step2Tip: Tap a role and then a color dot to change it; the preview updates straight away.
brand.step3Text: In the second step you see whether text and buttons read well. If a combination is hard to read, “Fix” suggests the closest shade that works.
brand.step4Text: Tick the services that should follow your brand and tap “Save colors”. When you change the colors, those services update by themselves.
brand.step4Tip: If you change a color by hand in a service, it stops following your brand: “Use brand colors” turns it back on.

hopla.title: Hoplà: files without cables
hopla.summary: Photos, videos and documents from phone to computer, computer to phone or between two phones, with no cables and no uploading to the internet.
hopla.step1Title: Open Hoplà and choose what to do
hopla.step1Text: Open Hoplà from the services, on a computer or a phone, and choose “Receive here” or “Send from here”: a QR code appears. The code works while the page stays open; “New code” makes another one.
hopla.step1Tip: Both devices on the same Wi-Fi: it’s the fastest way.
hopla.step2Title: Scan the code with the other phone
hopla.step2Text: Scan the code with the other phone’s camera: the Hoplà page opens, with nothing to install and no login. When you see “Connected”, you’re ready.
hopla.step3Text: On the sending device tap “Choose files”: photos, videos, documents, as many as you like. Check the list (the × removes a file) and tap “Send”. You can also switch direction without disconnecting, with “Receive here” and “Send from here”.
hopla.step3Tip: While sending, stay on the page with the screen on: if the connection drops, “Reconnect” picks up with the same files.
hopla.step4Text: The receiving device shows how many files are coming and how big they are. On a computer with Chrome or Edge, “Choose folder and receive” saves them straight into a folder; otherwise “Receive”. You can also decline.
hopla.step5Text: Follow the percentage of each file. At the end, download them on a computer; on a phone “Save” lets you choose where to put them (Photos, Files or an app). The bin removes the ones you don’t need.
hopla.step5Tip: Files go straight from one device to the other: they don’t go through KUMANI’s servers and nobody keeps them.

firma_pdf.title: Sign PDF
firma_pdf.summary: Signature, date and text on your PDFs from your phone or computer, without uploading them anywhere.
firma_pdf.step1Text: Open Sign PDF and tap “Choose the PDF to sign” (or drag it in, on a computer). The pages appear one below the other.
firma_pdf.step1Tip: The document opens on your device: it isn’t uploaded anywhere.
firma_pdf.step2Text: Tap “Signature”: type your name (pick a style), draw your signature with your finger or the mouse, or upload a photo of it. Choose black or blue ink and tap “Sign”.
firma_pdf.step2Tip: With “Remember my signature on this device” it’s ready next time.
firma_pdf.step3Title: Put it in the right place
firma_pdf.step3Text: Tap the spot on the document where the signature goes. Drag it to move it and use the gold dot to resize it; the pencil changes it, the bin removes it.
firma_pdf.step4Text: “Date” adds the date (today or another one, in two formats) and “Text” adds words like “Read and approved”. You place and move them like the signature, on any page.
firma_pdf.step5Text: Tap “Download the signed PDF”: the file keeps the original name plus “-signed”. On a phone you can also share it straight away, for example on WhatsApp.
firma_pdf.step5Tip: It’s a simple electronic signature: fine for approvals, forms and many contracts; it doesn’t replace a qualified digital signature.

rete_antitruffa.title: Anti-Scam Network
rete_antitruffa.summary: Report numbers, websites, IBANs and emails used for scams and see the community’s warnings: free for everyone.
rete_antitruffa.step1Text: In “Alerts” you see how many reports there were in the last 7 days, the scams on the rise and the latest warnings confirmed by the Staff.
rete_antitruffa.step1Tip: Turn on “Scams of the week” to get a notification every Monday with the most reported scams.
rete_antitruffa.step2Text: In “Report” choose what to report (phone, website, IBAN, email, social profile or QR code), the type of scam and describe what happened. You can add a screenshot: only the Staff sees it.
rete_antitruffa.step2Tip: No names of people: report only the numbers, websites and details used by scammers.
rete_antitruffa.step3Text: Once the Staff confirms, anyone checking the same detail with SVAT, IBAN Check or CheckMail sees the red community warning, with the type of scam and members’ accounts.
rete_antitruffa.step4Text: Type the number that called or texted you: see whether it has been reported, which country it’s from and whether it’s a premium-rate number.
rete_antitruffa.step4Tip: Scammers can spoof numbers: if in doubt, don’t give codes or money and call the official number back yourself.
rete_antitruffa.step5Text: In “Mine” follow the status of each report and how many people it warned. Confirmed reports earn you KU Karma and the Bronze, Silver and Gold Guardian badges.

scudo_dati.title: Data Shield
scudo_dati.summary: Find out whether your email or a password has ended up in a data breach and what to do straight away.
scudo_dati.step1Text: Tap “Check” in “Your email”: we check your account email against known data breaches. It’s free.
scudo_dati.step2Text: You can also check a family member’s or your business email. You see which breaches it appears in and which data was exposed.
scudo_dati.step2Tip: It costs 3 KU Karma, deducted only if the check succeeds.
scudo_dati.step3Text: Type a password and tap “Check”: we tell you whether it has already appeared on scammers’ lists. If so, change it wherever you use it.
scudo_dati.step3Tip: The password never leaves your device: only the start of its fingerprint is sent.
scudo_dati.step4Text: Follow the steps to use Google’s “Results about you”: find where your phone, address and email appear and ask for them to be removed from Search.

trova_lavoro.title: Find a Job
trova_lavoro.summary: Job offers from many sources, with accurate filters and an anti-scam check.
trova_lavoro.step1Text: Type the job you’re looking for and choose country, city and radius. Contract, hours and “Advanced filters” narrow the results down.
trova_lavoro.step1Tip: Under the button you see this week’s credit: only result pages actually read are counted.
trova_lavoro.step2Text: Offers come from several sources, without duplicates and with scam signals already checked. You see salary, date and why it matches your search, then open the ad to apply.
trova_lavoro.step3Text: Tap the star to save an offer to “Favourites” and save a search to run it again with one tap.
trova_lavoro.step4Text: Before applying, create or update your CV with KUMANI CV.
trova_lavoro.step4Tip: A real job never asks for money or bank details before the interview.

proposte.title: Community proposals
proposte.summary: Suggest ideas to improve KUMANI and support other members’ ideas.
proposte.step1Text: In Community you’ll find the “Proposals” card and the “Most supported proposals” strip. Tap “All proposals” to see them sorted by support, new or done.
proposte.step2Text: With the Plus or Pro plan tap “Make a proposal”: choose what it’s about, write a clear title and explain the idea. While you type we show similar proposals.
proposte.step2Tip: You can make one proposal a week; the Staff checks it before publishing.
proposte.step3Text: Open a proposal and tap “Support this proposal”. Support is anonymous: only the number is shown. Supporting is free for everyone.
proposte.step4Text: The Staff replies and updates the status: new, being evaluated, planned, done. You get a notification when a proposal you support moves forward.
proposte.step4Tip: If your proposal gets built you receive KU Karma.

convivium.title: KUMANI Convivium
convivium.summary: The table opens with a link: create an evening (drinks, pizza, dinner…), invite whoever you like and watch the table fill up. Guests reply without signing up.
convivium.step1Text: Pick the occasion, write a title, the day and time and where you’re meeting. If you like, set the seats at the table, the cost per person (or “My treat”) and a few words for your guests. “I’m coming too” is already ticked: your name will be first at the table.
convivium.step1Tip: Add the Google Maps link so the place becomes clickable for everyone.
convivium.step2Text: Tap “Create and get the link”, then “Send on WhatsApp”: the message is already written. You can also copy the link or share it with other apps.
convivium.step3Text: Whoever opens the link sees the evening, the cost and who’s already in. They just write their name and tap “I’m in!”, “Maybe” or “Can’t”: no sign-up. They can change their mind any time from the same link.
convivium.step3Tip: At the bottom of the invite there’s an invitation to join KUMANI with your code.
convivium.step4Text: In your evening you see who replied and get an alert for every “I’m in”. The day before, we remind you and the guests who are KUMANI members. From here you can edit, cancel or delete it.

calendario.title: Connected calendar
calendario.summary: Your KUMANI commitments in the calendar you already use: Google Calendar, iPhone or Outlook.
calendario.step1Text: In the Dashboard, under the agenda, tap “Connect to Google Calendar, iPhone or Outlook”. You’ll find your personal link.
calendario.step2Text: Tap “Google Calendar”, “iPhone and Mac” or “Outlook” and confirm: the KUMANI calendar appears among your calendars.
calendario.step2Tip: If the button doesn’t work, copy the link and paste it into your calendar (“From URL” or “From Internet”).
calendario.step3Text: Evenings, events, trips, appointments, bills and deadlines reach your calendar. Changes are made in KUMANI: Google picks them up every few hours.
calendario.step4Text: Anyone with the link can see your commitments. If you think someone else has it, tap “Regenerate the link”: the old one stops working.

lumen.title: KUMANI LUMEN
lumen.summary: Record your videos looking straight into the camera: the script scrolls on screen and you speak naturally.
lumen.step1Text: Tap “New script”, give it a title and write what you want to say. It saves automatically and below you see the words and estimated length, so you know if it fits a Reel.
lumen.step1Tip: Short sentences, one idea per line: they sound more natural on video.
lumen.step2Text: Tap “Start LUMEN”: the front camera opens full screen. The first time, your phone asks for camera and microphone permission.
lumen.step2Tip: Hold the phone at eye level, ideally on a stand.
lumen.step3Text: Tap ▶: after the countdown the text scrolls. Read the line on the gold line: move it up or down by dragging the handle on the right, so it sits close to the camera.
lumen.step3Tip: With AI mode (the waves icon) the text moves only while you speak and stops when you stop.
lumen.step4Text: From the settings icon choose text size, speed (from turtle to rabbit) and countdown seconds; you also see the estimated length. From the palette choose font and text colour. At the top choose the format: 9:16 for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, 16:9 for YouTube.
lumen.step5Text: Tap the red button: countdown, then recording starts together with the text. When you’re done tap the square: watch the video, download it or share it right away.
lumen.step5Tip: The video stays on your phone: KUMANI doesn’t upload or see it.

vox.title: KUMANI VOX
vox.summary: Automatic subtitles for your videos: your voice becomes text on your phone, you pick the style and download a video ready to post.
vox.step1Text: Tap “Choose the video” and pick one from your gallery, up to 3 minutes (for example one recorded with LUMEN). Set the video language and the transcription: “Accurate” makes fewer mistakes, “Fast” is lighter.
vox.step1Tip: The first time your phone downloads the AI model (77 or 250 MB): better on Wi-Fi. Then it stays on your phone.
vox.step2Text: Tap “Create subtitles”: VOX listens to the video and writes every word with its timing. Keep the page open until it finishes.
vox.step2Tip: Video and voice stay on your device: KUMANI doesn’t upload or see them.
vox.step3Text: “Word by word” colours the word you’re saying, like in Reels; “Classic” and “Box” show the whole sentence. Choose size, position, colour and all caps: the preview on the video updates right away.
vox.step4Text: Reread the lines and fix any wrong words, such as names. Tap the time on the left to hear that moment of the video.
vox.step5Text: Tap “Create the video with subtitles”: the video plays once and the captions are burned in. Then download it or share it right away. If you use YouTube or a video editor, download the .srt file too.
vox.step5Tip: Keep the screen on while the video is created: it takes as long as the video.

captio.title: KUMANI CAPTIO
captio.summary: Captions and hashtags ready to copy for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and LinkedIn.
captio.step1Title: Choose the network and describe the post
captio.step1Text: Tap where you’re posting (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or LinkedIn) and write in a few words what the post is about. If you like, add the photo: the AI looks at it to write better.
captio.step1Tip: The photo is shrunk on your phone and only used to write: it isn’t saved.
captio.step2Text: Enter your business and city: they’re used for local hashtags. Then choose goal (inform, sell, get comments, tell a story), tone, length and whether you want emojis. CAPTIO remembers them for next time.
captio.step3Text: Tap “Write the captions”: in a few seconds you get three different options, each with an attention-grabbing first line.
captio.step4Text: Hashtags are split into general, your sector and your area. Tap the ones you don’t like to remove them: only active ones are copied.
captio.step5Text: Tap “Copy with hashtags” under the option you prefer, open the network and paste. Always reread before posting.

diarium.title: KUMANI DIARIUM
diarium.summary: 30 days of ready posts: what to publish, where and how, with reminders in your Agenda.
diarium.step1Text: Write what you do, your area, when you want to start and what you want to highlight. The more precise you are, the more tailored the ideas.
diarium.step2Text: Choose the networks (even more than one), how many posts a week you can manage and the tone. DIARIUM remembers them for next time.
diarium.step2Tip: Better a few good posts: 3 a week are enough to start.
diarium.step3Text: Tap “Prepare the calendar”: in about half a minute you get 30 days of posts, split by week, with day, network, format (post, reel, story, carousel), idea and first line.
diarium.step4Title: Write the post in a moment
diarium.step4Text: Under each post tap “Write the caption” to open CAPTIO with everything ready; for reels tap “Script with LUMEN” and record looking into the camera.
diarium.step5Text: When you publish, tick the post: the bar shows how many you’ve done. Posts to do also appear in your Agenda, on the right day.

imago.title: KUMANI IMAGO
imago.summary: Graphics for posts and stories with your colours and your logo, ready in a minute.
imago.step1Text: Tap on what you want to say (offer, news, event, quote, opening hours, notice or tip) and the format: post 4:5, square, or story 9:16.
imago.step2Text: Every template starts with an example: swap it for your own text. The preview updates as you type.
imago.step2Tip: Keep it short: people skim-read on social media.
imago.step3Text: Add a background photo if you like, and choose your colours: “Your colours” are the ones from your Business Profile. With “Primary colour” (the background) and “Secondary colour” (highlighted text and details) you can pick any colour you want.
imago.step4Text: If you've uploaded your logo in your Business Profile, IMAGO will add it at the top automatically. Check the name and contact details at the bottom (phone, website or profile).
imago.step5Text: Tap “Create the image”, then download it or share it straight away on Instagram, Facebook or WhatsApp.

forma.title: KUMANI FORMA
forma.summary: Trim your videos and fit them to every social network, all on your phone.
forma.step1Text: Tap “Choose the video” and pick it from your gallery. It stays on your device: it's never uploaded.
forma.step2Text: Move the “Start” and “End” sliders to keep only the part you need. Use ▶ to review the clip you've chosen.
forma.step3Text: Reels and TikTok (9:16), square (1:1), portrait post (4:5) or YouTube (16:9). The preview shows you straight away how it'll look.
forma.step4Text: “Fill” crops the video: use the slider to choose what stays centred. “Fit” shows the whole video with a blurred version of itself behind. You can also mute the audio.
forma.step5Text: Tap “Create the video”: the clip plays once, then you can download or share it. Keep your screen on until it's finished.

tutela.title: KUMANI TUTELA
tutela.summary: The checks for a safe social media profile, the scams to recognise and what to do if your account gets stolen.
tutela.step1Text: At the top you'll see how protected your profile is: it goes up every time you tick off a check you've done.
tutela.step2Text: Tap a check to read where to find it in your settings (two-step verification, password, recovery, logins, backup codes) and tick it off once you've done it.
tutela.step3Text: Decide what to show and to whom: private profile, tags, location, photos of children, personal data.
tutela.step4Text: Read up on the most common scams on social media: fake support, paid blue ticks, cloned profiles, WhatsApp codes, fake collaborations.
tutela.step5Text: Follow the 4 steps: official recovery page, password change, warning your contacts, reporting it. From here you can also open Speculum and the Anti-Scam Network.

shop.title: KUMANI Shop
shop.summary: Your online shop: products, card payments, pickup or shipping, and orders.
shop.step1Text: In the «Payments» tab, complete your Business profile (name, VAT number, address and email, which customers see before paying) and connect your Stripe account: that’s where your sales money arrives.
shop.step1Tip: The shop can’t open until both steps are done.
shop.step2Text: In the «Shop» tab, choose the name, the link address, a description and the cover photo. At the top you’ll find the link to copy and the buttons to open or close the shop.
shop.step3Text: Choose whether customers pick up, you ship, or both: for shipping, set the cost and the amount above which it’s free. Then check the terms of sale, withdrawal and returns we’ve prepared and tap «Save».
shop.step3Tip: Have your adviser check the terms before you open.
shop.step4Text: In the «Products» tab, tap «Add a product»: name, price, photo, description and availability. You can also take products from your Inventory: stock goes down by itself with every sale.
shop.step5Text: Every sale lands in the «Orders» tab with the customer’s name, what they bought and whether they pick up or need shipping. Mark it «Ready for pickup» when it’s ready; if you cancel an order, the customer’s refund starts automatically.

offermaker.title: OfferMaker AI
offermaker.summary: A promotion ready in minutes: page, QR code, short link and WhatsApp messages written by AI.
offermaker.step1Title: What do you want to promote?
offermaker.step1Text: Describe the offer and the price in your own words, then tap «Next». With «Use my business profile» your business name and address fill in by themselves.
offermaker.step1Tip: At the top you can see how many offers you can still create with AI today: check your answers carefully before creating one.
offermaker.step2Text: Say who you’re targeting and where, your strength and what you want to achieve (calls, bookings, visits). In the last step choose the style and the WhatsApp number to receive messages on, then tap «Create my offer».
offermaker.step3Text: The AI prepares the title, description, button text and three WhatsApp messages. Change anything you like: editing the texts is unlimited. Then tap «Publish campaign».
offermaker.step3Tip: The AI is a starting point: always check prices, dates and details before publishing.
offermaker.step4Text: Here you’ll find the short link to copy, the QR code to download and how many people opened the offer. With «View landing page» you see it as your customers do. You can fix the texts whenever you like and tap «Save changes».
offermaker.step5Text: Anyone who opens the link or scans the QR sees your offer and, with one tap on the button, messages you on WhatsApp with a ready-made text. Share the link on social media and put the QR in your shop window or on the counter.

cronobioma.title: KUMANI CRONOBIOMA
cronobioma.summary: Your body clock: chronotype, ideal day, sleep diary, shifts, travel and reminders.
cronobioma.step1Text: Answer the questions about your real sleep times, on work days and free days. If you took the test before signing up, tap «use that result».
cronobioma.step1Tip: The test is open to everyone at kumani.io/cronobioma: share it with anyone you like.
cronobioma.step2Text: Find out whether you are a lark, an early bird, intermediate, a late riser or an owl, your natural sleep and your social jet lag: how much you shift between work days and weekends.
cronobioma.step3Text: The dial shows your ideal day: light, focus, exercise, last coffee, dinner, screens and sleep. Tap a moment to see why. Set the time you get up and how many hours you want to sleep, then save.
cronobioma.step3Tip: Sleep times are health data: the first time you save we ask for your consent, and you can delete everything whenever you like.
cronobioma.step4Text: Every morning note when you went to bed, when you woke up and how you slept. The chart shows how regular your times are and you get a practical tip.
cronobioma.step5Text: In Shifts you find the plan for night work or changing hours, in Travel how to adapt to a new time zone. With Reminders you add the daily alerts to your phone’s calendar.

tempus.title: KUMANI TEMPUS
tempus.summary: Online bookings: your page where clients pick a service and a time, and your diary with all your appointments.
tempus.step1Text: Choose the address of your page, then add the services people can book: name, duration and, if you like, the price. The duration is used to work out the free times. Use the arrows to change the order and the eye to hide a service from the page.
tempus.step1Tip: The logo, address and phone number on the page come from your Business profile.
tempus.step2Text: Tick your opening days and add up to 3 time slots per day. Below, choose how often to offer a time, the break after each appointment, the minimum notice, how far ahead people can book and until when they can cancel online. At the bottom, add holidays and closing days.
tempus.step3Text: In the «Your page» tab, tap «Publish the page». Copy the link, send it on WhatsApp or download the QR code for your shop window or counter. Before publishing you can look at the preview.
tempus.step3Tip: Put the link in your Instagram bio, on your Landing Page and at the end of your messages.
tempus.step4Text: On your page, clients pick the service, the day and a free time and leave their name, phone and email. No sign-up needed. They get a confirmation, a reminder the evening before and a link to cancel.
tempus.step5Text: Every new booking reaches you by email, in the bell and on your phone. The diary shows the week: call or message on WhatsApp with one tap, add a note, cancel (the client gets an email) or mark a no-show. With «Add» you enter appointments taken over the phone.

angolo_bambini.title: Kids Corner
angolo_bambini.summary: Creative games for children, with KUMI as their guide: they colour, invent animals, make music and draw in an area locked by the parent code. No AI, and nothing leaves the phone.
angolo_bambini.step1Text: The first time, choose a 4-digit code. From then on the Kids Corner stays locked: your child cannot go back to the rest of KUMANI, change page or share drawings without the code. The code stays only on the phone.
angolo_bambini.step1Tip: If you forget the code, sign out of KUMANI and sign back in with your password: you create a new one, and children and drawings are kept.
angolo_bambini.step2Text: Add each child with a name, boy or girl, and age. The age decides how detailed the drawings are and how many colours there are. Name, age and drawings stay only on this phone: they never reach KUMANI or anyone else.
angolo_bambini.step2Tip: Adding, changing or deleting a child needs the code.
angolo_bambini.step3Text: KUMI, the octopus with a crown, welcomes your child and gives a new tip at every tap, also out loud. Below are the five games. At the top: stars won, the album, sounds, voice and the padlock to leave.
angolo_bambini.step4Text: Your child taps a colour and then a part of the drawing. When the figure is fully coloured it wakes up and KUMI dances in to praise your child by name. Then the figure waves, dances, jumps or goes to sleep. From age 5 there are also missions (“colour the tummy red”) that earn stars.
angolo_bambini.step4Tip: There are 20 drawings, KUMI included: “New drawing” picks one that suits the age, the grid shows them all. “Clean” removes all the colours to start again.
angolo_bambini.step5Text: Pick one piece at a time: head, ears or horns, body, arms, feet, tail and wings. The creature gets a funny name, then it is coloured and comes to life like the other drawings.
angolo_bambini.step6Text: Each colour is a note: the child colours the flowers one after another, presses “Play” and their character dances to the tune. They can change instrument and speed, save up to 12 songs and delete them on their own.
angolo_bambini.step6Tip: The notes are chosen so that any combination sounds good.
angolo_bambini.step7Text: A blank sheet with magic brushes: rainbow, sparkles, stamps, eraser and background. With the mirror every stroke is repeated on the other side. “Done! To the album” puts the drawing in the album. “Clean” empties the sheet, and “Undo” brings it back.
angolo_bambini.step8Text: Finished drawings go into each child’s album. Saving them on the phone, sending them on WhatsApp or printing the PDF needs the parent code. You can also print the same drawing without colours, to colour with real crayons.
angolo_bambini.step9Text: To go back to KUMANI tap the padlock at the top and enter the code: KUMI waves goodbye and you leave. The “back” button also stays inside the game.
angolo_bambini.step9Tip: To really lock the phone on KUMANI use “Guided Access” on iPhone (Settings › Accessibility) or “App pinning” on Android (Settings › Security): your child cannot leave even with the Home button.

fonometro.title: Sound meter
fonometro.summary: Measure noise in decibels, keep a log of the loudest moments and download a PDF with a chart and times.
fonometro.step1Text: Tap «Start measuring» and allow the microphone. Keep the phone still, with the microphone uncovered, and the screen on.
fonometro.step1Tip: Nothing is recorded: the phone only measures how loud it is.
fonometro.step2Text: The big number is the decibels right now, with a colour and a phrase saying what it compares to. Below you see the chart, the average, the maximum and the moments above the threshold.
fonometro.step3Text: In «Threshold and calibration» choose from how many decibels a noise is logged (at night at home 40–45 dB are already annoying). If you have a real sound meter, move the calibration until the numbers match.
fonometro.step4Text: Tap «Stop»: you see the length, average, maximum and the list of noisy moments with time and duration. Add the place and notes, then «Save to the log» or «Download the PDF».
fonometro.step4Tip: A phone microphone is not calibrated: the values are an estimate, useful to compare times and places.

metronomo.title: Metronome
metronomo.summary: A metronome with sound, light and vibration that can listen to your playing and tell you if you’re in time.
metronomo.step1Text: Change the beats per minute with ±1, ±5 or the slider, from 30 to 250, or tap «Tap tempo» in rhythm and the metronome takes it from you. Then tap «Start».
metronomo.step2Text: Choose the time signature (2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 6/8…) and tap a beat to make it strong, normal or muted. In «Subdivision» add eighth notes, triplets or sixteenth notes between beats.
metronomo.step3Text: Choose click, woodblock or bell and the volume. With «Light only» the metronome is silent: it marks the beats with light (and vibration, where the phone allows it).
metronomo.step4Text: With «Speed up gradually» the tempo rises by a few beats every few bars, up to the speed you choose. The practice timer stops the metronome after 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes.
metronomo.step5Text: Turn on «Listen if I’m in time»: the microphone hears your hits and compares them with the beats. Green is in time, orange early or late. At the end you see the percentage, your tendency and a chart of your hits.
metronomo.step5Tip: Use headphones or «Light only», so the microphone doesn’t hear the metronome click.

accordatore.title: Tuner
accordatore.summary: Tune guitar, bass, ukulele, violin, viola and cello to the cent, also step by step with a drawing of the instrument.
accordatore.step1Text: Tap the instrument and choose the tuning (standard, half step down, Drop D, DADGAD…). «Chromatic» recognises any note.
accordatore.step2Text: Tap «Start», allow the microphone and play one string at a time. The tuner finds the nearest string by itself, or tap it yourself to hear the reference tone.
accordatore.step3Text: The needle shows how many cents are missing: on the left the note is low (tighten the string), on the right it is high (loosen it). In the green zone it’s right: after a moment the string gets a tick.
accordatore.step4Title: Step by step, one string at a time
accordatore.step4Text: With «Step by step, one string at a time» you see a drawing of the instrument: the string to tune is gold and the arrow shows which way to turn the peg. When it’s right, the guide moves to the next string by itself.
accordatore.step5Text: You can change the reference A (415 to 466 Hz), the note names (C D E or Do Re Mi), the precision and the sensitivity. Your choices stay saved on the phone.
accordatore.step5Tip: Nothing is recorded: the note is recognised on the phone.

vocale_sospetto.title: Suspicious voice message?
vocale_sospetto.summary: Let KUMANI listen to a strange voice message and find out if it has the typical signs of a scam.
vocale_sospetto.step1Text: You can upload the voice message file, let the microphone listen while it plays (even from another phone) or paste its text, if WhatsApp has already transcribed it.
vocale_sospetto.step2Text: In WhatsApp press and hold the voice message, tap Forward or Share, then «Save to Files». Come back here, tap «Upload the voice message» and choose it.
vocale_sospetto.step2Tip: The first time, voice recognition is downloaded (about 80 MB): Wi-Fi is better.
vocale_sospetto.step3Text: After listening you see a colour-coded verdict (from «No scam signs found» to «Careful: this really looks like a scam»), the signs found with the sentence from the message and the transcribed text.
vocale_sospetto.step4Text: Don’t send money, codes or photos of documents, and call the person back yourself on the number you know. If it’s a scam, tap «Report the number to the Anti-Scam Network» to protect others too.
vocale_sospetto.step4Tip: The message is listened to and transcribed on your phone: we don’t upload it and nobody listens to it.

testo_protetto.title: Protected Text
testo_protetto.summary: Use ChatGPT or Gemini without handing over personal data: names, IBANs and addresses become neutral labels.
testo_protetto.step1Text: Paste the text or upload a file (PDF with text, Word, TXT): minutes, a report, an email, a contract. «Try an example» shows you right away how it works.
testo_protetto.step2Text: The personal data found is highlighted: names, tax codes, IBANs, phone numbers, emails, addresses, dates of birth. Tap an item to leave it visible and add words to hide.
testo_protetto.step3Text: Labels like [PERSON 1] replace the data. Tap «Copy» and paste it into the AI you prefer.
testo_protetto.step3Tip: Always reread the text before sharing it: recognition helps a lot but it isn’t infallible.
testo_protetto.step4Title: Put the data back into the answer
testo_protetto.step4Text: Paste the AI’s answer in step 4: the labels turn back into the real names and data, only here on your phone.
testo_protetto.step4Tip: The text never leaves the device: the «key» stays only in this browser for 7 days.

carte_antitruffa.title: Anti-Scam Cards
carte_antitruffa.summary: The most common scams, card by card: read how the bait works, answer 3 questions and complete the album.
carte_antitruffa.step1Text: At the top you see how many cards you have and how many are missing for the bronze, silver and gold shield. «All», «To collect» and «Mine» choose which to show.
carte_antitruffa.step2Text: Tap a card: on the front there’s the bait as it really arrives, the channel and the danger. Flip it to see how to spot it and how to defend yourself.
carte_antitruffa.step3Text: Tap «Take the card: 3 questions». Answer correctly and the card goes into your album. If you get one wrong, reread it and try again tomorrow.
carte_antitruffa.step3Tip: One card a day: with the questions or captured by a check, only one arrives each day.
carte_antitruffa.step4Title: Capture them and warn your loved ones
carte_antitruffa.step4Text: When SVAT, CheckMail, the QR check or the Anti-Scam Network stop a real scam, its card arrives with a green frame. «Warn someone» sends the card on WhatsApp.

scanner.title: Scanner
scanner.summary: From paper to PDF in seconds: KUMANI finds the edges, straightens the page and makes it easy to read.
scanner.step1Text: Tap «Take a photo» to photograph the document, «Pick photos» for ones you already have, or «Open PDFs» to merge them. With «Auto capture» the camera shoots by itself when the sheet is whole and still.
scanner.step2Text: KUMANI finds the edges of the sheet: if needed, drag the 4 corners. Then choose the filter (Enhanced, Black & white, Greyscale or Original), rotate and tap «Add page».
scanner.step3Text: All pages end up in the same list: move them up or down, rotate, fix or remove them. «Choose pages» saves only the ones you need.
scanner.step4Text: Name the file, choose the quality («Normal», or «Light» for emails and portals) and tap «Download PDF» or «Share».
scanner.step4Tip: Documents stay on your phone: KUMANI processes them in the browser and doesn’t upload them.

fototessera.title: ID Photo
fototessera.summary: The 35×45 mm photo for ID card, passport and driving licence, without a photo booth: white background and the right size.
fototessera.step1Text: Read the tips: someone else takes the photo from about 1.5 metres, in front of a light wall, with even light. Look straight ahead, mouth closed, no hats or sunglasses.
fototessera.step2Text: With «Guided shot» the camera checks distance, position, straight head, open eyes and light live, and shoots by itself when everything is right. You can also choose a photo you already have.
fototessera.step3Text: KUMANI finds the face, straightens the photo, adds the white background and sizes the head correctly. Use the arrows to move and rotate; the «Photo check» tells you what to improve.
fototessera.step3Tip: The check is a guide: the final word belongs to the office that issues the document.
fototessera.step4Text: Tap «Download photo» for online portals, or «10×15 sheet with 6 photos» to print at a photo shop or kiosk and cut along the grey lines.

lettera_presentazione.title: Cover letter
lettera_presentazione.summary: The letter to send with your CV, with ready-made sentences to tap and the same look as your CV.
lettera_presentazione.step1Text: Tap «New letter». If you have a KUMANI CV, your name, contact details, language and look are taken from it. Give the letter a name so you can find it again, for example “Shop assistant – Ross & Co.”.
lettera_presentazione.step1Tip: Write one letter for each company: with «Duplicate» you start from one you have already written.
lettera_presentazione.step2Text: Write the role, the company and the person or office you are writing to. The subject writes itself and the ready-made sentences are completed with these details.
lettera_presentazione.step3Text: Pick a group («To begin», «Why I'm a good fit», «Why this company», «Availability», «To finish») and tap a sentence: it goes into the text and you can change it as you like. 3 or 4 short paragraphs are enough.
lettera_presentazione.step3Tip: Words in square brackets, like [number], must be completed: in the preview they are yellow.
lettera_presentazione.step4Text: Tap «Save the letter», then «Preview» to see it as it will be printed. «Download PDF» saves it on your phone, «Share» sends it straight away.

registro_ore.title: Hours and shifts log
registro_ore.summary: Log your shifts with one tap and check your payslip: regular hours, overtime, Sundays and holidays.
registro_ore.step1Text: The first time, write where you work, pick a colour and the normal hours per day and per week (usually 8 and 40). The hourly pay is optional: it is used for the gross estimate.
registro_ore.step1Tip: If you work in more places, add them from «Your workplaces», at the bottom of the page.
registro_ore.step2Title: Start and end of a shift
registro_ore.step2Text: When you start, tap «Start shift»: the clock of the current shift starts. When you finish, tap «End shift» and check the time. You can correct it if needed.
registro_ore.step3Text: With «Add a shift» you write day, start, end and break. You can tick «Public holiday» (for example a local feast day) and «Night shift». «Repeat yesterday’s shift» copies yesterday’s shifts to today.
registro_ore.step3Tip: If you finish after midnight, write the time as it is (18:00 – 02:00): the shift counts on the day it started.
registro_ore.step4Text: At the top you see hours worked, regular hours, overtime, Sundays, holidays and the gross estimate. In the calendar, tap a day to see its shifts; further down there is the week-by-week comparison.
registro_ore.step5Text: Tap «Download the month’s PDF», write your name and download the log with the shifts, the totals and space for signatures. There is also the CSV file, which opens in Excel.
registro_ore.step5Tip: It is an estimate to check your payslip: your contract may count hours differently.

candidature.title: My job applications
candidature.summary: All your applications in one place: who you sent your CV to, interviews and when to call back.
candidature.step1Text: Every time you send your CV, tap «Add an application»: company, role, status and date sent. If you like, add the interview, when to call back, the contact person and the link to the ad.
candidature.step2Text: Every day you find today’s and tomorrow’s interviews, who to call back and who has not answered for more than 10 days. Call, write an email or put the interview in your calendar with one tap.
candidature.step3Text: In the list, tap the status next to the company to change it: «Sent», «Interview booked», «Offer»… You can search, filter by status and sort by next things to do.
candidature.step3Tip: With «Download the list (CSV)» you get all your applications in one file.
candidature.step4Text: Tap a company to open its card: status, when to call back, contacts and what has happened. From here you can also open your CV and your cover letter.

ricevuta_occasionale.title: Occasional work receipt
ricevuta_occasionale.summary: The receipt for occasional work without a VAT number: KUMANI works out withholding tax, revenue stamp and net amount.
ricevuta_occasionale.step1Text: In «Your details» write your full name, tax code, address and the town of the receipt. The IBAN is optional. You write them only once.
ricevuta_occasionale.step2Text: Tap «New receipt» and choose the client or «+ New client». «No withholding» for a private person; «With withholding (withholding agent)» for a company, a professional, a public body or a condominium, who keeps back 20%.
ricevuta_occasionale.step2Tip: If in doubt, ask the client whether they apply withholding tax.
ricevuta_occasionale.step3Text: Write what work you did and the gross fee: withholding, total and net are calculated automatically. Above €77.47 a €2 revenue stamp is needed: choose whether the client or you pay for it.
ricevuta_occasionale.step4Text: Tap «Create the receipt»: it takes the number after the last one. Download the PDF, sign it and hand it over. When you get paid, tap «Mark as paid».
ricevuta_occasionale.step4Tip: A wrong receipt is cancelled: only the last one of the year can be deleted, so the numbers stay in order.
ricevuta_occasionale.step5Text: At the top you see gross fees, withholding, net, collected and still to collect. KUMANI warns you when you get close to €5,000 in the year: above that you must register with INPS (Gestione Separata). With «Download the year’s CSV» you have everything for your accountant or tax office.

note_spese.title: Expense reports
note_spese.summary: Work expenses and mileage with a photo of the receipt, in a PDF to hand in to your company.
note_spese.step1Text: Tap «New expense report» and write the name (for example “Milan trip, March”), the dates, your name and who it is for. If the company gave you an advance, write it: it is taken off the total.
note_spese.step1Tip: Make one expense report for each trip or each month.
note_spese.step2Text: Inside the report, tap «Receipt photo» to photograph the receipt and write the amount, or «Add expense». Expenses are grouped by day and by type: meals, lodging, trains, taxis, parking, fuel.
note_spese.step3Text: Choose «Mileage, own car», write from where to where, the kilometres and the rate per km: the amount is calculated automatically. Tick «Return trip (km × 2)» to count the trip twice.
note_spese.step3Tip: The rate is set by the company: ask the HR office. You write it only once.
note_spese.step4Text: At the top you see how much you are owed, split by type. «Download PDF» creates the report with signatures and photos of the receipts. Then tap «Mark as handed in» and, when the money arrives, «Mark as reimbursed».

documento_componibile.title: Fillable document
documento_componibile.summary: Build a form from blocks and download a PDF with real fields, to fill in on a phone or computer.
documento_componibile.step1Text: Tap «New document» and choose «Blank document» or a ready-made template: registration, photo release, quote request, proxy and more. With «Preview» you see it before using it.
documento_componibile.step2Text: At the bottom choose the fixed parts (title, subtitle, text, image, line, signature space) and the parts to fill in (short or long field, date, tick box, drop-down menu).
documento_componibile.step3Text: Tap a block to open it: change the label, the menu items or the hint. Tick «Required» or «Half width (side by side)» for two fields next to each other. Use the arrows to move it up or down.
documento_componibile.step4Text: Tap «Preview» to see the A4 page: the golden boxes become the PDF’s fields to fill in. Then tap «Save».
documento_componibile.step5Text: Tap «Download the fillable PDF» and send it to whoever needs to fill it in: they can do it with any PDF reader, on a phone or computer. With «Open it and try filling it in» you try it straight away.
documento_componibile.step5Tip: Want to sign it yourself before sending it? Open it in Sign PDF.

s1.title: Hands that lend you a hand.
s1.notes: This is KUMANI: hands that lend you a hand. An ecosystem of digital tools useful every day, for individuals, families and the self-employed. Let’s see what it is, what it offers, how points and donations work and, at the end, how much it costs.

s2.title: What the name means
s2.sub: Two words, one promise: hands together.

1.3: Group, people working side by side.

2.2: the oldest Italian word for work
2.3: The hands that build, help, create.

3.2: hands together
3.3: And inside it you can hear “umani”, humans: people are at the centre.

s2.notes: KU comes from the Japanese kumi: a group, people working side by side. MANI is the oldest Italian word for work: hands. KUMANI means hands together. And if you hear the Italian word umani, humans, inside it, that is no accident.

s3.title: Why KUMANI was born

1.2: Extraordinary people, with big hearts and an empty toolbox.

2.2: They needed extra hands: one for the QR code, one for the agenda, one for the quote, one to breathe.

3.2: One place, all the tools, an honest price. Not dreams: tools.

s3.notes: KUMANI was born from watching self-employed people: salespeople, consultants, craftspeople. They had ideas and drive, but not the tools. That is how the promise was born: one place, all the tools, an honest price.

s4.title: The KUMANI Manifesto
s4.sub: Six sentences that guide every choice.

3.2: we build workbenches.

4.2: the same for everyone and clearly stated.

5.2: that’s why we also teach you to breathe.

6.2: public rules, real benefits, no tricks.

s4.notes: The manifesto is our identity card. We do not promise earnings: we provide tools. The price is public and the same for everyone.

s5.title: KUMANI in four numbers
s5.sub: One account, services that talk to each other.

1.3: {free} free for everyone, the others with Plus and Pro

2.3: from security to work, from home to wellbeing

3.2: languages
3.3: Italian, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Russian

s6.title: Everything you need, in {areas} areas
s6.sub: {total, plural, one {# service} other {# services}} with one account. Here are some names for each area.

3.2: {name_agenda}, {hub_spendly}, {name_casaauto}, KUMANI Travel

6.2: Listings, Kordata, Time Bank, Events, Affinity, {hub_giochi}

s6.notes: Services are grouped by need, in {areas} areas: {total} in total. Some examples for each area; at the end we see them all, one by one.

s7.title: An ecosystem: the areas talk to each other
s7.sub: What you do in one service goes where it’s needed, without copying anything.

2.2: departures and passport expiry in your agenda

3.2: the table QR leads to your contacts

4.2: from quote to job, all the way to payment

5.2: every tool you use grows your KU Karma
