privacyPage.metaDescription: How KUMANI processes users’ personal data, in short.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: How we process your personal data, in short.
privacyPage.notice: This is a short version. The full policy is being prepared and will be published on this page.
privacyPage.s1: The data controller is {company}, which runs KUMANI. For any question about your data you can write to {email}.
privacyPage.s2: Account data: email and password (encrypted, nobody can read it).|Profile data: first name, last name, country, city and whatever you choose to add.|The content you create in the tools, such as agenda, expenses, deadlines, quotes or listings.|Payments: handled by Stripe; KUMANI never sees or stores card details.|Technical data, such as IP address and browser type, for the security of the service.|Usage data: when you use KUMANI and for how long (length of visits, phone or computer), for internal statistics on how the platform is used; deleted after 13 months.|Anti-scam reports: the details you report (numbers, websites, IBANs, emails, profiles) and your account of what happened; others only see the number of reports, the type of scam, the account and at most your city, never your name; screenshots are seen only by the Staff and deleted after the check.
privacyPage.s3: To provide the service you chose (performance of the contract).|To comply with legal obligations, such as tax rules.|For security and to prevent abuse and scams (legitimate interest).|To show your story on the homepage only if you consent, which you can withdraw at any time.|We do not send advertising emails without your consent.
privacyPage.s4: Only the technical providers needed to run KUMANI (hosting, database in Europe, email delivery, payments with Stripe), who use the data only for that purpose. We do not sell your data to anyone.
privacyPage.s5: As long as your account is active. You can delete your account from your profile: the related data is deleted or anonymised, except what the law requires us to keep (for example tax records of payments). The security log (IP address, browser type and pages opened in case of failed logins, intrusion attempts or unusual use) is kept for 30 days and then deleted.
privacyPage.s6: Access your data and get a copy.|Correct it or ask for it to be deleted.|Restrict or object to processing.|Withdraw consent at any time.|Lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of your country.
privacyPage.s7: KUMANI uses only technical cookies, needed to keep you logged in and make the site work. We do not use profiling or advertising cookies.
privacyPage.s7list: “sb-…-auth-token” (Supabase, our database provider): keeps you securely logged in to your account. It lasts up to 400 days or until you log out.|“sb-…-auth-token-code-verifier”: used only when you sign in with a link received by email or reset your password; it is needed for a few minutes.|“NEXT_LOCALE”: remembers the language you chose. It lasts 1 year.|Cloudflare Turnstile: anti-robot check on the login, registration and password recovery pages, to protect accounts from automated attacks. It is a Cloudflare security service, loaded only on those pages.|Stripe: when you pay you go to Stripe's pages, which use their own cookies for payment security and fraud prevention (see Stripe's privacy policy).|Browser storage (localStorage): small preferences such as the open tab or a draft not yet sent. They stay on your device and are not sent to us.
privacyPage.s7consentCookie: “kumani_consent”: remembers that you have seen the cookie notice and any choices you made. It lasts 6 months, then we show it again.
privacyPage.s7note: These are all technical, necessary cookies: by law your consent is not required. You can still delete or block them in your browser settings, but some features (such as staying logged in) will stop working. If we use optional cookies in the future, for example for statistics, we will ask for your consent first and you will be able to change it at any time from “Cookie preferences”.
privacyPage.s8: If you choose to connect Google Calendar, KUMANI receives from Google only your Google email address and permission to create and manage the “KUMANI” calendar in your account. We use it solely to write your KUMANI plans (appointments, reminders, bills, deadlines, events and trips) to that calendar: we do not read or change your other calendars. The permission is stored encrypted, is not shared with anyone and is not used for advertising or to train artificial intelligence models. You can disconnect Google Calendar at any time from the “Connected calendar” page or from your Google account settings: the “KUMANI” calendar is removed and the permission deleted. KUMANI’s use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacyPage.s9: To exercise your rights or for any privacy question, write to {email}.

fincheck.subtitle: A quiz on your money habits, a budget check-up using your Spendly data and an action plan to balance your books better.
fincheck.disclaimer: FinCheck is for educational purposes only: it helps you understand your habits and organise your household budget. It is not financial, tax or investment advice and it does not suggest any financial products. For important decisions, consult a licensed professional. Your results are private: only you can see them.
fincheck.introTitle: How are you doing with money?
fincheck.introText: 15 simple questions about your habits: at the end you'll discover your profile, your strengths and what to improve.
fincheck.introPoint1: The quiz: 15 questions on awareness, saving, debt, spending and the future.
fincheck.introPoint2: The check-up: using your Spendly data, we work out what your budget looks like.
fincheck.introPoint3: The plan: up to 3 concrete goals to tick off, then retake the quiz and see your progress.

fincheck.profile_planner_text: You know your numbers, save methodically and have a cushion for the unexpected. Now you can work on your long-term goals.
fincheck.profile_builder_text: You have good foundations: some habits are already solid, others need strengthening. A few adjustments can give you much more peace of mind.
fincheck.profile_balancer_text: You make it to the end of the month, but with little margin: one surprise expense can put you in difficulty. The first step is knowing exactly where your money goes.
fincheck.profile_drifter_text: Right now your money is making the decisions. The good news: a few new habits are enough to take back the wheel, one step at a time.
fincheck.advice_awareness: For one month, record every expense in Spendly, even your coffee. At the end of the month you'll have a real map of your money: it's the foundation for everything else.
fincheck.advice_saving: Pay yourself first: as soon as your pay arrives, move a fixed share (even 5-10%) to a separate account. Your first goal is an emergency fund equal to 3 months of expenses.
fincheck.advice_debt: List all your repayments with amount and due date. Avoid new instalment purchases for non-essentials and, as soon as you can, pay off the smallest one first: it frees up room and keeps you motivated.
fincheck.advice_spending: Do a subscription "clean-up" and compare electricity, gas and phone deals once a year. For non-essential purchases, use the 48-hour rule before buying.
fincheck.advice_future: Write down a goal with an amount and a date, divide it by the months left and put it in your budget like a fixed expense. A written goal is far more likely to be reached.
fincheck.praise_awareness: You know where your money goes: that's the basis of every good choice. Keep it up.
fincheck.praise_saving: You save methodically and you're ready for the unexpected. Great work.
fincheck.praise_debt: Your repayments are under control and you pay on time: keep up this habit.
fincheck.praise_spending: You spend mindfully and check for better deals. Well done.
fincheck.praise_future: You have clear goals and think about the future: you're on the right track.
fincheck.checkupLocked: The check-up reads the income and expenses you record in Spendly and shows you, with numbers, what your budget looks like. It's included from the Plus plan.
fincheck.checkupNoData: The check-up needs at least one full month of income in Spendly (ideally 3 months), together with your fixed and variable expenses.

fincheck.ruleText: A simple benchmark: about 50% of income for needs, 30% for wants and at least 20% to put aside.

fincheck.ind_debt_text: Repayments take up {percent} of your income: avoid new ones until you're below 10%.
fincheck.ind_subscriptions_ok: Subscriptions weigh little on your budget.
fincheck.ind_subscriptions_text: You pay {amount} a month in subscriptions, {annual} a year: review the ones you rarely use.

fincheck.planIntro: Up to 3 goals chosen from the areas and indicators to improve. Tick them off once done.
fincheck.planEmpty: No urgent goals: your habits are solid. Retake the quiz in 3 months to check.
fincheck.planRetakeHint: Retake the quiz in 3 months to see your progress: you get KU Karma the first time and then every 3 months.
fincheck.goal_emergencyFund: Build an emergency fund of {amount} (3 months of expenses), putting aside {monthly} a month.
fincheck.goal_emergencyFund_generic: Build an emergency fund equal to 3 months of expenses, a little each month.

fincheck.goal_saveAuto: Set up an automatic saving of {amount} a month (10% of income) as soon as your pay arrives.
fincheck.goal_saveAuto_generic: Set up an automatic saving of at least 10% of income as soon as your pay arrives.

svat.title: Website checker: is this site legit or a scam? · SVAT
svat.description: Check whether a website, VAT number or QR code can be trusted before you pay: a 0–100 trust score based on domain, security, legal pages and reviews.
svat.heading: How to tell if a website is legit before you buy
svat.intro: An online shop with prices that look too good to be true, a site created last week, a QR code stuck on a parking meter: before you pay, it pays to check. SVAT analyses the address in seconds and gives you a trust score from 0 to 100, showing what looks fine and what doesn’t.
points: Check a website: domain age, DNS, security, content, legal pages and reviews
Check an Italian or EU VAT number: whether it’s active and who it’s registered to
Check a QR code before opening it, to avoid trap links
See which checks are OK, worth watching or risky

faq.q: How can I tell if a website is a scam?
faq.a: No check gives absolute certainty, but some signs help a lot: a domain registered only a few days ago, no VAT number or legal pages, missing or suspicious reviews, prices far below normal. SVAT checks these and other signs and sums them up in a score.

faq.q: Does a high score mean the website is 100% safe?
faq.a: No. The score is a hint, not a guarantee: even a site with a good score can hide problems. Before paying, use payment methods with buyer protection, such as a credit card, and be wary of anyone asking for instant bank transfers or top-ups.

faq.q: Can I check a foreign VAT number?
faq.a: Yes, SVAT checks Italian and EU VAT numbers and tells you whether they are active and who they are registered to.

verifica_iban.title: IBAN checker: validate an IBAN before a bank transfer
verifica_iban.description: Check that an IBAN is correctly written, which country and bank it belongs to, and which scam warning signs to look for before you send money.
verifica_iban.heading: How to check an IBAN before making a bank transfer
verifica_iban.intro: An instant bank transfer can’t be cancelled, so it’s worth checking the IBAN before you pay. IBAN Check tells you whether it’s correctly written and which country it’s from, and for Italian IBANs it shows the bank and branch. The check happens entirely on your phone: the IBAN is never sent or stored.
points: Check whether the IBAN is correctly written and where the mistake is
See the country and, for Italian IBANs, the ABI (bank), CAB (branch) and account number
Get the scam warning signs to look for based on what you’re paying for
No data sent: the check stays on your device

faq.q: Does a valid IBAN mean the recipient is honest?
faq.a: No. A valid IBAN only means the code is correctly written, not who is behind it. Many scams use perfectly valid IBANs: look at the other signs too, such as pressure to hurry or a price that’s too low.

faq.q: How do I find out which bank an Italian IBAN belongs to?
faq.a: An Italian IBAN contains the ABI code, which identifies the bank, and the CAB code, which identifies the branch. IBAN Check splits them out and shows them to you.

faq.q: What should I do if I’ve already sent money to a scammer?
faq.a: Contact your bank straight away to ask for the transfer to be recalled, and report it to the police and your national cybercrime or fraud reporting service. The faster you act, the better the chance of getting your money back.

scudo_dati.title: Has my email been in a data breach? Free check · Data Shield
scudo_dati.description: Find out for free if your email was caught in a data breach, which data was exposed and whether a password has already leaked. With tips on what to do right away.
scudo_dati.heading: How to find out if your email was caught in a data breach
scudo_dati.intro: Every year millions of accounts are stolen from online shops, social networks and services: emails, passwords and phone numbers end up online and are used for scams and break-ins. Data Shield checks your email against known data breaches, shows you what was exposed and tells you what to do.
points: Free check of your account email
List of breached sites, with year and exposed data
Password check without it ever leaving your device
Practical tips: passwords, two-step sign-in, scam emails

faq.q: How do I know if my email has been breached?
faq.a: With Data Shield you check your email against known data breaches (source: XposedOrNot): you see which sites it appeared in, in what year and which data was exposed.

faq.q: Is it safe to check my password?
faq.a: Yes: your password never leaves your phone or computer. Only the start of its fingerprint is sent (k-anonymity, Pwned Passwords) and the comparison happens on your device.

faq.q: What should I do if my email is in a data breach?
faq.a: Change the password of the breached site and of every site where you reused it, turn on two-step sign-in and be wary of emails and texts that mention the breach.

checkmail.title: Suspicious email? Check if it’s phishing · CheckMail
checkmail.description: Received a suspicious email? CheckMail checks the sender, links, attachments and wording and tells you if the phishing risk is low, medium or high.
checkmail.heading: How to spot a phishing email
checkmail.intro: Held parcels, suspended accounts, refunds waiting to be claimed: scam emails imitate the banks, couriers and services you use every day. With CheckMail you upload or paste the suspicious email and in seconds you see what doesn’t add up: sender, links, attachments and words meant to rush you.
points: Analyses the real sender, even when the display name is fake
Checks hidden and shortened links
Flags dangerous attachments and requests for personal data
Tells you what to do: don’t click, don’t reply, contact the company through its official channels

faq.q: How can I tell if an email is phishing?
faq.a: The most common signs are a sender that doesn’t match the company, links leading to addresses other than the official ones, urgent wording (“within 24 hours”) and requests for passwords, codes or card details. CheckMail looks for them for you.

faq.q: Can I check an email on my phone?
faq.a: Yes: just copy the sender, subject and text with the links. On a computer you can also upload the email file (.eml or .msg) for a more thorough check.

faq.q: I clicked a suspicious link: what should I do?
faq.a: Don’t enter any details. If you already have, change that service’s password straight away, tell your bank if cards or accounts are involved, and turn on two-step verification.

verifoto.title: Real photo or AI-generated? Check it with VeriFoto
verifoto.description: Find out if a photo was created or edited with artificial intelligence: a risk percentage, camera data and a map of the areas that may have been edited.
verifoto.heading: How to tell if a photo is AI-generated or edited
verifoto.intro: Fake profiles, listings with photos taken from the internet, images generated by artificial intelligence: before you trust a photo, you can check it. VeriFoto looks for the traces left by the camera or by editing software and shows you a risk level.
points: Risk percentage that the photo is AI-generated or edited
Clues such as digital credentials and camera data
Edit map to see the suspicious areas
Second opinion from an AI detector and reverse image search

faq.q: Can VeriFoto say for certain whether a photo is fake?
faq.a: No, no tool can do that with certainty. VeriFoto gathers clues and sums them up in a risk level: if in doubt, don’t trust it.

faq.q: How can I find out if a photo was stolen from the internet?
faq.a: Search for the same image with Google Lens or TinEye: if it appears on other sites under other names, that’s a strong sign of a fake profile or listing. VeriFoto takes you straight to these searches.

faq.q: Are my photos saved?
faq.a: The basic checks happen on your device. Only if you choose the AI detector’s second opinion is a reduced copy of the photo sent, and only after you’ve agreed to it.

antitruffa.title: Anti-Scam Manual: the most common scams and how to avoid them
antitruffa.description: Text, email, phone, chat, online shopping and investment scams: real examples, the 10-second test and what to do right away if you’ve been scammed.
antitruffa.heading: The most common scams and how to spot them
antitruffa.intro: The fake courier, the fake bank adviser, the son or daughter texting from a new number, the investment with returns too good to be true: scams change shape but look alike. The Anti-Scam Manual gathers them into chapters, with real examples and what to do right away. You can download it, print it and share it with the people you love.
points: The 10-second test: 6 questions to ask yourself before you click, reply or pay
The 6 golden rules that prevent most scams
Chapters on emails and texts, phone calls, the doorstep, chats, shopping and investments
What to do right away if you’ve been scammed

faq.q: What are the most common scams today?
faq.a: Among the most common are texts and emails from a fake courier or fake bank, calls from fake advisers, messages from relatives asking for money from a new number, fake online listings and investments with promised returns.

faq.q: Can I give the manual to my parents?
faq.a: Yes, that’s exactly what it’s designed for: you can print it, save it as a PDF or send the link via WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram or email.

faq.q: What should I do if I’ve been scammed?
faq.a: Block your cards and accounts straight away by calling your bank, change your passwords, keep messages and receipts, and report it to the police and your national cybercrime or fraud reporting service. The manual has a chapter with all the steps.

documento_sicuro.title: Send a photo of your ID safely with a watermark · Safe Document
documento_sicuro.description: Before sending your ID card, add a watermark with the purpose and date and cover the details that aren’t needed. The photo stays on your phone.
documento_sicuro.heading: How to send a photo of your ID card safely
documento_sicuro.intro: Renting, a new job, online purchases: we’re often asked for a photo of an ID document. But a copy in circulation can be used for identity theft. With Safe Document you add text stating the purpose and date, cover the details that aren’t needed and remove hidden data, such as GPS location.
points: Watermark with purpose, recipient and date repeated across the whole photo
Cover the document number, signature or photo if they aren’t needed
Removes hidden data, such as GPS location
The photo is never uploaded or stored: everything happens on your phone

faq.q: Why add a watermark to an ID document?
faq.a: Text such as “For rental agreement only – 3 October” makes the copy much harder to use for other purposes, such as opening accounts or making purchases in your name.

faq.q: Can the recipient still read the details?
faq.a: Yes, the watermark keeps the details readable. If the recipient needs something you’ve covered, you can create a new copy without covering it.

faq.q: Is the photo of my document uploaded to the internet?
faq.a: No. The photo stays on your phone and the original isn’t touched: you only download or share the protected copy.

fincheck.title: Financial literacy quiz and budget check-up · FinCheck
fincheck.description: 15 questions in 3 minutes to discover your money profile: saving, debt, spending and the future, with practical tips and an action plan.
fincheck.heading: How good are you at managing your money?
fincheck.intro: Making it to the end of the month, putting something aside, not getting crushed by repayments: it all starts with knowing where your money goes. FinCheck is a 15-question financial literacy quiz that shows your strengths and the areas to improve across five areas, with a tip for each one.
points: 15-question quiz, about 3 minutes, on awareness, saving, debt, spending and the future
Score and traffic light for each area, with practical tips
Budget check-up with the 50/30/20 rule if you use Spendly
Action plan with up to 3 concrete goals

faq.q: What is the 50/30/20 rule?
faq.a: It’s a simple way to split your income: about 50% for needs (housing, bills, groceries), 30% for wants and 20% for savings and debt. FinCheck works it out on your real budget if you use Spendly.

faq.q: Does FinCheck give investment advice?
faq.a: No. FinCheck is financial education: it helps you understand your habits and balance your budget. It doesn’t recommend financial products or investments.

faq.q: Who can see my results?
faq.a: Only you: your quiz and check-up results are private.

spendly.title: Household budget app: income, expenses and bills · Spendly
spendly.description: Track your personal budget month by month: income, bills, fixed and variable expenses, balance and the year’s trend. Simple, from your phone.
spendly.heading: How to keep a household budget without spreadsheets
spendly.intro: Knowing how much comes in and how much goes out is the first step to saving. Spendly is your personal budget: you record income, bills, fixed and variable expenses and see month by month whether you’re in the black, need to be careful or are struggling.
points: Yearly dashboard with income, expenses and net balance
Recurring bills that repeat automatically, with what you actually paid
Variable expenses split by category
Colours that tell you at a glance whether the month is positive or critical

faq.q: How do you make a household budget?
faq.a: Start with the month’s income, then subtract fixed costs (rent, repayments, subscriptions), bills and variable expenses (groceries, fuel, leisure). Spendly does the maths for you and shows you the balance.

faq.q: Do I have to link my bank account?
faq.a: No. In Spendly you enter the items yourself: there’s no need to link accounts or cards.

faq.q: Can I use Spendly with FinCheck?
faq.a: Yes: once you’ve recorded a few months of income and expenses, FinCheck uses your Spendly data for the budget check-up.

trova_lavoro.title: Job search with filters and scam job alerts · Find a Job
trova_lavoro.description: Search job offers from multiple sources with no duplicates, filter by contract, hours, salary and remote work, and get suspicious listings flagged.
trova_lavoro.heading: How to search for jobs and avoid job scams
trova_lavoro.intro: There are lots of job ads, often repeated, and some hide scams: paid courses, easy money, requests for cash or documents. Find a Job searches offers from multiple sources, removes duplicates, applies your filters and flags suspicious listings. You apply directly on the listing’s website.
points: Offers from multiple sources in a single search, with no duplicates
Filters for contract, hours, minimum salary, date and remote work
Listings showing scam warning signs are flagged
Favourites and saved searches to review at your own pace

faq.q: How can I spot a fake job ad?
faq.a: Be wary of anyone who asks for money for courses, kits or registration, promises high earnings with no experience, asks for documents or bank details before the interview, or only contacts you via chat. Find a Job flags these signs.

faq.q: Does KUMANI publish job ads?
faq.a: No. KUMANI doesn’t host job ads or collect CVs: it searches offers published on other websites and takes you to the original listing to apply.

faq.q: Can I search for remote jobs only?
faq.a: Yes, with the “Remote or hybrid only” filter.

kumani_cv.intro: A CV sent today may already be out of date tomorrow. With KUMANI CV you create a European-style CV, choose from three templates and download the PDF. Every PDF has a QR code linking to your public page: anyone who scans it always sees the latest version.

Experience, education, skills, languages, certifications and links
PDF to download and a public link to share on WhatsApp and by email
Multiple CVs, for example one in English and one in another language

faq.q: What is a European CV?
faq.a: It’s a tidy, easy-to-read CV format, with personal details, experience, education, languages and skills in clear sections. It’s widely used in Italy and across Europe.

faq.q: What is a QR code on a CV for?
faq.a: Anyone holding your printed or PDF CV can scan the QR code and see the latest version, even if you’ve updated it in the meantime.

faq.q: Can I make my CV in another language?
faq.a: Yes, choose the content language when you create the CV. You can have more than one, in different languages.

menu.title: QR code menu for restaurants, cafés and bars · KUMANI Menu
menu.description: Create a digital menu for your venue with table QR codes, photos, allergens and multiple languages. Update prices and sold-out dishes in seconds.
menu.heading: How to create a QR code menu for your restaurant
menu.intro: Reprinting the menu every time a price changes costs time and money. With KUMANI Menu you create an online menu for your restaurant, bar or pizzeria: customers scan the QR code at the table and read it in their own language, with photos, allergens and the dish of the day.
points: Printable QR code and table card ready to go
Menu in multiple languages, with automatic translation of dishes
Allergens and attributes such as vegan or gluten-free
Sold-out dishes and dish of the day updated in one click

faq.q: How does a QR code menu work?
faq.a: Place the QR code on the table: customers scan it with their phone camera and the menu opens, with no app to download.

faq.q: Can I show allergens?
faq.a: Yes, for each dish you choose the allergens and attributes, which customers see next to the dish.

faq.q: Can the menu be in other languages for tourists?
faq.a: Yes, choose the menu languages: customers see it in their own language. Missing translations can be completed with AI.

fidelity.title: Digital loyalty card app with stamps on the phone · Kumi Card
fidelity.description: A stamp card for your shop without paper cards: stamps via QR on the customer’s phone, rewards, stats and customers you can bring back.
fidelity.heading: How to create a digital loyalty card for your business
fidelity.intro: Paper stamp cards get lost and tell you nothing about your customers. Kumi Card is a digital loyalty card: you give the stamp with a QR code, customers collect it on their phone without downloading an app, and you see who comes back, when, and who is close to a reward.
points: Stamps given via QR code from the till, even several at once
Customers see their stamps and reward on their phone, no app needed
Stats: stamps per week, peak days and hours, average return
Customers close to a reward you can contact on WhatsApp, if they’ve given consent

faq.q: Do customers have to download an app?
faq.a: No, they scan the QR code with their phone camera and the card opens in the browser.

faq.q: Can I run the till from a tablet?
faq.a: Yes, open till mode on the shop’s phone or tablet; on other devices it’s unlocked with the PIN you choose.

faq.q: What kinds of businesses is it for?
faq.a: Cafés, hairdressers, beauty salons, shops, pizzerias and any business with returning customers.

preventivi.title: Create PDF quotes and estimates on your phone · KUMANI Quotes
preventivi.description: Create professional quotes with your logo, VAT number and automatically calculated items, download the PDF and send it via WhatsApp or email.
preventivi.heading: How to write a professional quote in minutes
preventivi.intro: A clear, tidy quote makes a difference with customers. With Quotes you create documents with your letterhead, line items and an automatically calculated total, and send them as a PDF on WhatsApp or by email, even from your phone.
points: Header with logo, company name, VAT number and contact details
Items with quantity and price, total calculated automatically
Saved customers to reuse on your next quote
PDF to download and send, editable at any time

faq.q: What should a quote include?
faq.a: The details of whoever issues it and of the customer, a description of the work or products with quantities and prices, the total, the payment terms and the validity date.

faq.q: Can I send the quote on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Yes, you download the PDF and share it on WhatsApp or by email.

faq.q: Does a quote replace an invoice?
faq.a: No, a quote is a proposal to the customer. Invoices must be issued as required by law.

digital_receipt.title: Proof of delivery or loan receipt online · Digital Receipts
digital_receipt.description: Create a receipt for a delivery, a loan, keys or documents: the recipient confirms it from a link or QR code, with no account needed.
digital_receipt.heading: How to get proof of handing over items, keys or documents
digital_receipt.intro: Lent something, handed over keys or documents? With Digital Receipts you create a receipt with a photo and date, send it with a link or QR code and the recipient confirms they received it. That way there’s a record of what was handed over and when.
points: Receipts for deliveries, loans, keys, documents and more
Recipient confirmation from the link, no account needed
Reminder for the return date of loans
PDF to download and status always visible: pending, confirmed or returned

faq.q: Does the recipient have to sign up?
faq.a: No, they open the link or scan the QR code and confirm with a tap.

faq.q: Can I use it when lending an item?
faq.a: Yes, set the return date: you get a reminder and when the item comes back you tap “Confirm return”.

faq.q: Is it legally binding?
faq.a: It’s a dated written record of what was handed over and confirmed by the recipient. For contracts or important matters, ask a professional for advice.

magazzino.title: Simple inventory management for small businesses · Magazzino PRO
magazzino.description: Track products, stock levels, goods in and out, minimum stock and reorder alerts, with barcode scanning and CSV export. From phone, tablet or computer.
magazzino.heading: How to manage stock for a small shop
magazzino.intro: Knowing what you have in stock, what’s running low and what your goods are worth prevents wrong orders and empty shelves. Magazzino PRO keeps your products, stock levels and movements in order and shows you when it’s time to reorder.
points: Products with cost, selling price, minimum stock and stock level
Goods in, goods out and stocktakes, with stock levels that update automatically
Find products by scanning the barcode
Stock value, products to reorder and CSV export

faq.q: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phone, tablet and computer, and you can scan barcodes with the camera.

faq.q: How do I know when to reorder?
faq.a: For each product you set the minimum stock: when the stock level drops below it, the product appears in the list to reorder.

faq.q: Can I give the data to my accountant?
faq.a: Yes, you can export products and movements as CSV, which opens in Excel.

neurobalance.title: Binaural beats and nature sounds for relaxation · Neurobalance
neurobalance.description: Audio sessions with binaural beats and nature sounds (rain, ocean, forest) for a relaxing break. Best listened to with headphones.
neurobalance.heading: Relaxing sounds to unwind and switch off
neurobalance.intro: A break of just a few minutes with a relaxing sound can help you switch off. Neurobalance combines binaural beat sessions, to listen to with headphones, and nature sounds such as rain, ocean and forest that you can mix as you like.
points: Sessions such as “Deep rest”, “Fluid focus” and “Mindful reset”
Nature sounds: rain, ocean, stream, forest, wind, fire, night and thunderstorm
Adjustable volume and sounds you can mix
Designed for relaxation, to listen to with stereo headphones

faq.q: What are binaural beats?
faq.a: They are two slightly different tones, one in each ear, that are perceived as a single beat. That’s why you need stereo headphones.

faq.q: Is Neurobalance a therapy?
faq.a: No, it’s designed for relaxation; it isn’t a therapy and doesn’t replace a doctor’s advice.

faq.q: Can I use it while studying or working?
faq.a: You can use it as background sound during a break or while you concentrate, at a low, comfortable volume. Don’t use it while driving.

oxygen.title: Guided 4-7-8 breathing exercise to relax · OXYGEN
oxygen.description: Three minutes of guided 4-7-8 breathing: breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 7, breathe out for 8. With a visual circle, sound and vibration.
oxygen.heading: How to do 4-7-8 breathing
oxygen.intro: When you’re tense, slowing down your breathing helps you calm down. OXYGEN guides you through 4-7-8 breathing: a circle expands and contracts with you, and with sound and vibration you can even do it with your eyes closed.
points: Guided session of about 3 minutes, or breathing only
Choose how many cycles to do: 4 are recommended
Sound and vibration so you can breathe with your eyes closed
Tips for doing it safely

faq.q: What is 4-7-8 breathing?
faq.a: It’s a breathing exercise: you breathe in for 4 seconds, hold your breath for 7 and breathe out slowly for 8.

faq.q: How many cycles should I do?
faq.a: The first time, do no more than 4 cycles. If you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally.

faq.q: Can I do it while driving?
faq.a: No. Do it sitting or lying down somewhere quiet. OXYGEN is a relaxation exercise, not a medical device.

focus.title: Online Pomodoro timer for studying and work · KUMANI Focus
focus.description: Work in intervals with the Pomodoro technique: 25 minutes of focus and a 5-minute break, or the rhythm you prefer, with sound and vibration.
focus.heading: How to stay focused with the Pomodoro technique
focus.intro: Staying focused for hours is hard; in short intervals it’s much easier. KUMANI Focus is a timer that alternates focus and breaks, with a long break every 4 sessions, and alerts you with a gentle sound at every switch.
points: Ready-made rhythms: Classic 25/5, Long 50/10, Short 15/3, or Custom
Sound, vibration and notification at every switch
Screen stays on during the session
Today’s sessions and minutes of focus

faq.q: What is the Pomodoro technique?
faq.a: It’s a time-management method: you work with full focus for 25 minutes, take a 5-minute break and, every 4 sessions, a longer break.

faq.q: Can I change the length of the sessions?
faq.a: Yes, choose one of the ready-made rhythms or set custom durations.

faq.q: Are my sessions saved?
faq.a: Today’s count stays only on your device and resets every day.

fabula.title: Online story dice: write a micro story · Kumani Fabula
fabula.description: Roll six story dice (character, place, object, emotion, action and mood) and write a micro story. The daily dice are the same for everyone.
fabula.heading: Six dice, one story: a creative writing game
fabula.intro: A creative writing game to train your imagination in a few minutes. You roll six story dice and write a micro story that uses every element. Each day the dice are the same for the whole community: you can read how others told a story with the same dice.
points: Six dice: character, place, object, emotion, action and mood
Daily roll that’s the same for everyone, or a free roll
60-second challenge if you want to test yourself
Community story gallery, with no leaderboards

faq.q: How do you play with story dice?
faq.a: Roll the dice, look at the elements that come up and write a short story that includes all of them. There are no rules on genre or style.

faq.q: How long should the story be?
faq.a: Up to 900 characters: a micro story of a few lines.

faq.q: Do I have to publish my stories?
faq.a: No, you can publish them in the gallery or keep them to yourself in “My stories”.

mandala.title: Draw mandalas online with your finger · Mandala KUMANI
mandala.description: Draw with your finger and your stroke becomes a symmetrical mandala: 6, 8, 12 or 16 segments, colours of your choice and PNG download. No skills needed.
mandala.heading: Drawing a mandala to relax
mandala.intro: Drawing a mandala helps you switch off, even if you can’t draw. In Mandala KUMANI you trace a line with your finger and it’s repeated symmetrically: in seconds, a mandala all of your own takes shape.
points: Symmetry with 6, 8, 12 or 16 segments
Dark or ivory background, brush, eraser, stroke width and colours
Undo and start again whenever you like
Download your drawing as a PNG and share it

faq.q: Do I need to know how to draw?
faq.a: No: the symmetry does almost all the work, and even a simple stroke becomes a mandala.

faq.q: Can I save my mandala?
faq.a: Yes, with “Download PNG” you save it and can share it, for example on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes, it’s designed for drawing with your finger on a phone or tablet, but it also works with a mouse.

memolife.title: Online planner with reminders, notes and contacts · MemoLife
memolife.description: Appointments, reminders, notes and contacts in one online planner, together with your bills and document expiry dates. On your phone or computer.
memolife.heading: A planner so you never forget anything again
memolife.intro: Appointments on the calendar, reminders on your phone, scattered notes and numbers in your contacts: MemoLife brings them together in one place. The calendar also shows your bills and document expiry dates, so you have everything under control.
points: Today, Calendar, Reminders, Notes and Contacts tabs
Spendly bills and Life Calendar deadlines in the calendar
Add everything from a single “+” button
On your phone or computer

faq.q: Can I see my bills in the calendar?
faq.a: Yes, the bills recorded in Spendly appear in the MemoLife calendar.

faq.q: Can I note when my ID card expires?
faq.a: Yes, add a document’s expiry date with Life Calendar and you’ll find it in the calendar.

faq.q: Do I need to install an app?
faq.a: No, MemoLife works in your phone’s or computer’s browser, and you can add KUMANI to your Home screen.

landing_page.title: Create a website for your small business in minutes · Landing Page
landing_page.description: One-page website builder for your business: introduction, services, contact details and WhatsApp, copy written with AI, your colours and a QR code to share.
landing_page.heading: How to create a business website without coding
landing_page.intro: A freelancer or a small shop needs a clear page to show customers: who you are, what you do and how to get in touch. With Landing Page you create it from your phone in minutes, at an address of your own (kumani.io/page/…), in the colours you choose, with copy prepared by AI from your answers.
points: Introduction, services and method copy written with AI, always editable
Three templates and the main colour you prefer
Ready-made blocks: services, about me, testimonials, gallery, opening hours and contact details
WhatsApp button, “Message me” form with messages in your area, plus a QR code and link to share

faq.q: Do I need to know how to code or own a domain?
faq.a: No. You fill in the blocks from your phone or computer and the page is published at kumani.io/page/ followed by the address you choose.

faq.q: Can people find the page on Google?
faq.a: Once published, the page has a title, description and business details for Google. How long it takes to appear in the results is up to Google.

faq.q: Can I change the text later?
faq.a: Yes, you can edit the text, photos, colours and blocks whenever you like: changes go live as soon as you save.

garage.title: Lease mileage tracking, deadlines and documents for cars and motorbikes · Kumani Garage
garage.description: Always know if you are within your lease mileage: day-by-day budget, end-of-contract projection and cost of extra km. Plus road tax, insurance, inspection, expenses and documents for cars and motorbikes.
garage.heading: How to keep track of your lease mileage
garage.intro: With a long-term lease, extra km are charged when you return the car, and people often notice too late. Kumani Garage works out your mileage budget day by day from the contract and tells you right away if you are on track, how many km per day you can still drive and what you might pay at the end.
points: Mileage budget accrued day by day, by contract month and year
End-of-contract projection and estimated extra-km cost
Road tax, insurance, inspection and service with reminders
Expenses recorded in Spendly too and photos of registration and insurance always with you

faq.q: How is lease mileage calculated?
faq.a: Divide the included km by the contract length: for example 40,000 km over 48 months is about 833 km a month. Kumani Garage does the maths day by day from the pickup date and compares it with your real mileage.

faq.q: What happens if I go over my lease mileage?
faq.a: When you return the car you pay every extra km at the price in the contract (usually a few cents per km). If you enter that cost, Kumani Garage shows how much you might pay at your current pace.

faq.q: Is it also useful for an owned car or motorbike?
faq.a: Yes: for owned cars and motorbikes you keep the deadlines (road tax, insurance, inspection, service), the expenses, which also go into Spendly, and photos of the registration and insurance.

casa.title: Home management: maintenance, bills, warranties and documents · KUMANI Casa
casa.description: Your whole home in one place: maintenance with reminders (boiler, air conditioner, detectors), utilities and bills, appliances with their warranty and your home documents.
casa.heading: How to keep home deadlines and documents in order
casa.intro: Boiler service, air conditioner filters, insurance, appliance warranties, contracts: home deadlines are many and scattered. KUMANI Casa gathers them for each home, reminds you ahead of time and keeps utility codes, receipts, manuals and documents at hand.
points: Ready-made maintenance tasks with their repeat and reminders
Utilities with customer number, supply point code and fault line, bills linked to Spendly
Appliances with receipt, manual and a reminder before the warranty ends
Contracts, policies, system certificates, energy certificate and floor plan, visible only to you

faq.q: How often should a boiler be serviced?
faq.a: It depends on the system manual and your local rules: servicing is usually yearly. In KUMANI Casa you pick the ready-made task and set the repeat that suits you.

faq.q: Can I keep more than one home?
faq.a: Yes: main home, second home or a home you rent out, each with its own deadlines, utilities, appliances and documents.

faq.q: Do I have to enter bills twice?
faq.a: No: the utility links to the bill you already have in Spendly (or you create it from there) and you mark it paid only once.

nexus.title: Daily online crossword and challenges with friends – KUMANI Nexus
nexus.description: A new crossword every day, the same for everyone, in Italian or English. Challenge 2 to 4 friends on a turn-based grid: even people who are not members can play from the link.
nexus.heading: The daily crossword, on your own or with friends
nexus.intro: Every day a new grid, the same for the whole community: you play on your phone with a keyboard designed for crosswords, the timer starts when you are ready and right words stay in place. With the Challenge, 2, 3 or 4 people play on the same grid taking turns: every word you find takes your colour and crossings earn extra points.
points: A new grid every day, in Italian or English
Words checked straight away and a hint that reveals a letter
Streak, time and a result image to share
Challenge for 2 to 4 players: join from the link, even without signing up

faq.q: Does the crossword change every day?
faq.a: Yes: a new grid arrives at midnight, the same for everyone.

faq.q: How does the Challenge with friends work?
faq.a: You create the game, send the code on WhatsApp and start it when there are 2 to 4 of you. In turn you try a word: if it is right it takes your colour and is worth 1 point per letter plus 3 for each crossing.

faq.q: Do the people I invite need an account?
faq.a: No: whoever receives the link can join with a name and play right away. At the end they can sign up for free.

clienti.title: Simple client management for tradespeople and small businesses · Clients & Jobs
clienti.description: Client cards with contacts, quotes, amounts to collect and next-step reminders, linked to your quotes.
clienti.heading: How to keep track of clients without complicated software
clienti.intro: When you work with clients, money is lost mostly through forgotten things: a quote to follow up, a balance to chase, a call put off. Clients & Jobs gives each client a card and tells you who to contact today and who still has to pay.
points: Client card with phone, WhatsApp, email and notes
The client’s quotes with accepted, collected and outstanding amounts
Next step with a date: who to call back today
New quote already filled in from the card

faq.q: Do I have to enter clients by hand?
faq.a: No: every saved quote adds or updates its client. You can also add new ones from the clients page.

faq.q: How does it know what a client owes me?
faq.a: It adds up accepted quotes (VAT included) and subtracts the online payments received through Quotes.

faq.q: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a: Yes: from the card you call, message on WhatsApp or send an email with one tap.

surpriseTpl.birthdayVoucher_howTo: Contact whoever delivers the gift to find out how to collect it.
surpriseTpl.wine_desc: An envelope with a toast among the vineyards inside.
surpriseTpl.wine_message: A winery visit with tasting: glasses, aromas and a beautiful view. Cheers!
surpriseTpl.wine_howTo: Book the winery visit on the day you prefer.
surpriseTpl.cooking_desc: The fortune cookie hides a class with a chef.
surpriseTpl.cooking_message: A cooking class with a chef: learn their secrets and then… will you invite me to dinner?
surpriseTpl.cooking_howTo: Pick a class date from those available and book.

surpriseTpl.graduation_desc: A golden box to celebrate the milestone.
surpriseTpl.graduation_message: All that hard work paid off: I’m so proud of you. This gift is to celebrate.
surpriseTpl.graduation_howTo: Contact whoever delivers the gift to find out how to collect it.
surpriseTpl.baby_desc: A balloon to celebrate the birth, with a lullaby.
surpriseTpl.baby_message: What joy! A little gift for you and the new arrival, with all our love.
surpriseTpl.baby_howTo: Contact whoever delivers the gift: they can also bring it home.
surpriseTpl.honeymoon_desc: An elegant envelope with a contribution to the trip.
surpriseTpl.honeymoon_message: For your honeymoon: a little something to make it even more beautiful. Best wishes!
surpriseTpl.honeymoon_howTo: Use it for an experience during the trip, whichever you choose.
surpriseTpl.dad_desc: Scratch to discover a day all for him.

surpriseTpl.dad_howTo: Pick the day and book: we’ll take care of the rest.

shop.policyTemplate:
Seller: the seller’s details are shown at the bottom of the shop page.

Right of withdrawal: if you are a consumer you can withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of receiving the goods, without giving a reason, by writing to the seller’s email. The refund is made within 14 days with the same payment method; return shipping costs are paid by the customer. Personalised or perishable products are excluded.

Warranty: consumers benefit from the 24-month legal guarantee of conformity under EU and Italian consumer law.

Shipping and pickup: preparation and delivery times are set by the seller. For any question, contact the seller.

shopPay.stateText_none: Follow the steps below: in about 10 minutes you connect your Stripe account and can receive payments for your shop and quotes.

shopPay.step1Text: These are the seller details customers see before paying. Missing:
shopPay.step2Text: By law, Stripe must verify who receives online payments. Prepare:
shopPay.prepare_id: A valid ID document (ID card, passport or driving licence), to photograph front and back
shopPay.prepare_iban: The IBAN of the account where you want to receive money, in the name of the business or the owner
shopPay.prepare_phone: Your phone, for SMS verification codes
shopPay.step3Text: Tap the button: the Stripe website opens. Here is what it will ask, in order:
shopPay.stripe_account_text: choose a password for your Stripe account (the email is already filled in). If you already have a Stripe account you can sign in with it.
shopPay.stripe_security_text: Stripe sends you a code by SMS: it’s mandatory and protects your money.

shopPay.stripe_owner_text: name, date of birth, home address and, if requested, a photo of the ID document.
shopPay.stripe_bank_text: enter the IBAN: that’s where your sales money arrives.
shopPay.stripe_review_text: check the details and confirm. Stripe brings you back here by itself.
shopPay.step3Tip: You can stop at any time: your details are saved and you resume from here with “Complete on Stripe”. The Stripe account is yours: KUMANI doesn’t see your documents or bank details.
shopPay.step3Done: Done: the Stripe account is connected and the details have been sent.
shopPay.step4Active: All set: Stripe has verified the account and payments are active.
shopPay.pending: Stripe is checking the details you sent: you don’t need to do anything, we’ll let you know when it’s done.

shopPay.req_address: Address (of the business or the owner)
shopPay.req_business: Business details (type, industry, website or description of what you sell)

hopla.infoTitle: How Hoplà works and usage rules
hopla.info1: Files travel from one device to the other over a point-to-point connection, like a video call. They don’t go through KUMANI’s servers or anyone else’s and nobody keeps them.
hopla.info2: The connection is protected by browsers’ standard encryption (DTLS): only your two devices can read the files.
hopla.info3: To bring the two devices together we briefly exchange only technical network data, such as their addresses. Never the content of the files.
hopla.info4: The code only works while this page is open, and every transfer must be confirmed by whoever receives it.
hopla.rule1: Only send files you have the right to use and share.
hopla.rule2: Illegal, violent, pornographic or offensive content, malware and files that violate other people’s privacy or rights are forbidden.
hopla.rule3: Hoplà is not storage or a backup: always keep a copy of your files.
hopla.rule4: Transfers depend on the network and the devices: switching networks or the screen turning off can interrupt them.
hopla.rule5: In case of misuse we may suspend access to Hoplà.

categoryHints.courier: Texts or emails about a parcel “on hold” with a link to pay small fees: they steal your card details.
categoryHints.bank: They call or write “from the bank” and ask for codes or to move your money to a “safe” account.
categoryHints.investment: Sure, quick profits, often with crypto and a “consultant” on WhatsApp.
categoryHints.gaming: A casino or betting site, often in crypto, gives you a big bonus; when you try to withdraw it asks for a “verification deposit” and then more money.
categoryHints.romance: Someone met online wins your trust and then asks for money for an emergency.
categoryHints.rental: Homes or cars for rent that don’t exist, with a deposit to pay straight away.
categoryHints.marketplace: Fake sellers or buyers on listings and marketplaces, payments outside the platform.
categoryHints.job: Easy job offers that ask for money to start or for your documents.
categoryHints.support: Fake technicians who get you to install software to control your phone or computer.
categoryHints.prize: Non-existent prizes, gifts or refunds you must pay for or leave your data to get.
categoryHints.phishing: Messages and pages that imitate well-known services to steal passwords and data.

scamTest.title: Am I being scammed?
scamTest.intro: Answer a few questions and find out whether someone is trying to scam you. A free, anonymous test based on the most common scams.
scamTest.howText: We show you 5 cards with typical scam situations. Answer honestly: at the end you get your risk level and what to do.
scamTest.howAnonymous: Anonymous: your answers stay only on your device
scamTest.howPdf: You can save the result as a PDF
scamTest.disclaimer: This test is for information only, not legal advice. If you have already lost money, contact your bank and the police right away.
scamTest.answerAll: Answer all three questions to continue.
scamTest.search_yes: Yes, nothing found or scam reports
scamTest.q_bank: Did you get an email, text or call from someone pretending to be your bank, post office, tax or pension office or a supplier, asking you to tap a link or call a number?
scamTest.q_tech: Did a so-called “technician” contact you saying your computer has a virus or a problem and offer to help?
scamTest.q_easy: Did a stranger message you on WhatsApp or Telegram offering easy money, work from home or investments with huge returns?
scamTest.q_family: Did you get a message from a new number of a child or relative (“Mum, I’ve changed my number”) urgently asking for money?
scamTest.q_parcel: Did you get a text about a parcel on hold, a fine or a bill to pay right away through a link?
scamTest.q_police: Did someone call claiming to be a police officer, lawyer or doctor about a relative’s accident, asking for money or jewellery?
scamTest.q_remote: Were you asked to install a remote-control app (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, QuickSupport) so they could “help” you?
scamTest.q_codes: Were you asked for card codes, PINs, passwords or a code sent by text, because it’s “needed to verify”?
scamTest.q_secret: Were you told NOT to tell anyone (family, bank, police) because the operation is “confidential”?
scamTest.q_hurry: Were you rushed, told to pay or authorise something RIGHT NOW or you’d lose money or face legal trouble?
scamTest.q_untraceable: Were you asked to pay with top-ups, gift cards (Amazon, Google Play), cash, crypto or a transfer to an account you don’t know?
scamTest.q_profit: Does the offer promise huge gains compared with what you pay, or prizes and wins you never looked for?
scamTest.q_data: Have you already given these people personal or bank details, login codes or photos of your documents?
scamTest.q_paid: Have you already made payments, top-ups or transfers to these people or companies?
scamTest.q_search: Searching the company, person or website on Google, do you find no clear information or reports of scams?
scamTest.desc_low: Your answers show no major signs of a scam in progress. Stay alert: scammers keep inventing new tricks.
scamTest.desc_medium: Some warning signs came up: you may have been contacted by a scammer. Stop and check before doing anything.
scamTest.desc_high: The warning signs are very strong: someone is very likely trying to scam you. Stop all contact and send no money or details.
scamTest.desc_damage: You have already given money or details: act now. The sooner you move, the better your chance of stopping payments and limiting the damage.
scamTest.urgent_bank: Call your bank on its official number (on the back of your card or on its website, not the one in the message): block cards and account and ask to stop the payments.
scamTest.urgent_remote: If you installed a remote-control app: disconnect the computer or phone from the internet now, uninstall the app and have the device checked.
scamTest.urgent_passwords: Change your email, bank and social media passwords from another safe device and turn on two-step verification.
scamTest.urgent_police: Report it to the police: call 112 (the emergency number across Europe) or go to a police station.
scamTest.urgent_postale: In Italy you can also report it to the Polizia Postale at commissariatodips.it.
scamTest.urgent_evidence: Keep the evidence: messages, numbers, emails, payment receipts. You can also save this result as a PDF.
scamTest.tip_bank: Don’t tap links or call numbers from the message: contact your bank or the office only through their official channels.
scamTest.tip_tech: Microsoft, Apple or your bank never call you about a virus: hang up and don’t pay for any “support”.
scamTest.tip_easy: Easy, guaranteed money doesn’t exist: block the contact and don’t send even a small “test” amount.
scamTest.tip_family: Call your relative on their usual number before sending money: it’s almost always a scammer.
scamTest.tip_parcel: Check parcels, fines and bills only on the official website or app, never through the text’s link.
scamTest.tip_police: The police never ask for money or jewellery at your door: close the door and call 112.
scamTest.tip_remote: Never install remote-control apps at a stranger’s request: with them they can see and control everything.
scamTest.tip_codes: No bank asks for PINs, passwords or text codes: never give them to anyone, even someone “verifying”.
scamTest.tip_secret: Whoever asks for secrecy wants to stop you asking for advice: talk to someone you trust now.
scamTest.tip_hurry: Rushing you is the scammer’s weapon: take all the time you need to check.
scamTest.tip_untraceable: Top-ups, gift cards and crypto can’t be recovered: whoever asks for them is almost always a scammer.
scamTest.tip_profit: Huge returns or prizes you never looked for are the classic sign of a scam: don’t pay anything.
scamTest.tip_data: You gave details or documents: keep an eye on your accounts and post, and check whether your data is circulating online.
scamTest.tip_paid: You paid: contact your bank right away to ask to block or dispute the payment.
scamTest.tip_search: No clear information or scam reports: stop, don’t go ahead with payments or signatures.
scamTest.safe_links: Keep not opening links and not replying to messages from strangers.
scamTest.safe_update: Keep your computer and phone up to date.
scamTest.safe_ask: At the slightest doubt, check with Speculum before trusting.

calendarFeed.googleStep1: Tap “Google Calendar” above: Google Calendar opens with the KUMANI calendar ready.
calendarFeed.googleStep2: Confirm with “Add”. If it doesn’t open: in Google Calendar go to “Other calendars” → “+” → “From URL” and paste the link.
calendarFeed.googleStep3: On your phone it appears in the Google Calendar app by itself (check that “KUMANI” is switched on).
calendarFeed.appleStep1: On your iPhone or Mac, tap “iPhone and Mac” above.
calendarFeed.appleStep2: Confirm with “Subscribe”, then “Add”: the calendar is called KUMANI.
calendarFeed.appleStep3: For more frequent updates: Settings → Calendar → Accounts → KUMANI → “Every hour”.
calendarFeed.outlookStep3: With Outlook on a computer: “Add calendar” → “From Internet” and paste the link.
calendarFeed.infoWhat: It includes Convivium evenings, events, trips, MemoLife appointments and reminders, Spendly bills and deadlines: from the last month to the next six.
calendarFeed.infoOneWay: It goes from KUMANI to your calendar: changes are made in KUMANI.

calendarFeed.googleApiText: Connect your Google account: KUMANI creates a “KUMANI” calendar and writes your plans to it as soon as you save them, with no waiting. It can’t see or touch your other Google calendars.

tutela.badge: Safe social media · Free for everyone
tutela.heroText: A few checks to run just once, the scams doing the rounds on social media, and what to do straightaway if your account gets stolen.
tutela.scoreHint: Tick off the checks you've done: tap a title to see how.
tutela.scoreDone: Great: you've done all the checks. Go over them again every so often!
tutela.section_basics_text: Five minutes that will save you from most account thefts.
tutela.section_privacy_text: What you show, to whom, and how to avoid giving away too much information.
tutela.section_scams_text: The most common ones on social media: if you can spot them, you won't fall for them.

twofa.title: Turn on two-step verification
twofa.text:
Besides your password, you'll need a code: so even if someone finds out your password, they won't be able to get in.
Instagram and Facebook: Settings → Accounts Centre → Password and security → Two-factor authentication.
TikTok: Settings → Security → Two-step verification.
An authenticator app is better than SMS, but SMS is better than nothing.

password.title: Use a different password for each social network
password.text: If a password is stolen somewhere else, scammers will try it on social media too. Use a long, different one for each account, for example three random words joined together. A password manager (even the one built into your phone) can remember them for you.

recovery.title: Check your recovery email and phone number
recovery.text: If you lose access, the platform will send your code there. Check that the email and phone number are yours and up to date, and that your email password is secure: whoever has your email can take back everything.

sessions.title: Check where you're logged in from
sessions.text: Under Password and security → Where you're logged in, you'll find connected devices. If you see one you don't recognise, log out of it and change your password.

backup.title: Save your backup codes
backup.text: When you turn on two-step verification, the platform gives you some backup codes: save them somewhere safe (not in your phone's photos). You'll need them if you lose your phone.

private.title: Make your profile private, if it's personal
private.text: If the profile is just for friends and family, make it private: only the people you approve will see your content. For a business you need to be public, but keep your personal profile separate from your work one.

tags.title: Decide who can tag and message you
tags.text: In your privacy settings, choose who can tag you, mention you and message you. Limiting this to people you follow cuts down spam and scams a lot.

location.title: Don't post your real-time location
location.text: Post your holiday photos once you're back home, and remove location tags from your stories: telling everyone your house is empty isn't a good idea.

kids.title: Be careful with photos of children
kids.text: Avoid photos of children in school uniform, with their name, or in recognisable places. If you do share them, do it only with a small group (e.g. Close Friends).

personal.title: Don't leave data that scammers can use
personal.text: Full date of birth, address, phone number and the name of your first pet are often the answers to security questions. Remove them from your profile or make them visible only to you.

fakeSupport.title: “Your account will be deactivated”
fakeSupport.text: Messages or emails that look like they're from Meta, Instagram or TikTok, asking you to click a link within 24 hours: that's phishing. Social networks never message you in chat to ask for your password. Only check through the app's own settings (Emails from Instagram / Alerts).

blueTick.title: A “blue tick” for money
blueTick.text: Anyone offering to verify your profile in exchange for money or your password is a scammer. Verification is only requested through the official app (e.g. Meta Verified).

clone.title: A friend's cloned profile
clone.text: A profile with a friend's photo and name asks you for money, top-up credit, or an urgent favour. Often the real friend already follows you. Call them on the phone before doing anything.

whatsappCode.title: “Can you forward me the code you got?”
whatsappCode.text: A contact (often with an already-stolen account) asks you for a 6-digit code sent by SMS: it's the code to take over your WhatsApp or your profile. Never share it, with anyone.

collab.title: Fake collaborations and work-from-home jobs
collab.text: Famous brands offering you a collaboration, or paid gigs for liking posts, that then ask for an “entry fee” or your card details. Genuine collaborations never ask you for money.

giveaway.title: Fake contests and prizes
giveaway.text: “You've won! Just pay for shipping”: this is a scam to steal your card details. Check that the profile running it is the official one (verified tick, years of posts, plenty of genuine followers).

videoLink.title: “Is this you in this video?”
videoLink.text: A message, sometimes from a friend, with a link and “is this you?”: it leads to a fake login page that steals your password. Don't click it, and let your friend know their profile has been hacked.

tutela.hackedTitle: If your account has been stolen
tutela.hacked1: Use the platform's official recovery page straightaway (below), and look for the platform's email about the change: it often has a “This wasn't me” link.
tutela.hacked2: Change the password of your email and of any accounts using the same password.
tutela.hacked3: Let friends and customers know through another channel: they shouldn't send money or codes to whoever is messaging from your profile.
tutela.hacked4: Report it on KUMANI's Anti-Scam Network and, if money is involved, report it to the Italian Postal Police.

cronobioma.heroText: Discover your chronotype and your ideal day: when to get light, when to focus, your last coffee and the right time to sleep.
cronobioma.motto: “Your body has a clock. Learn to read it.”
cronobioma.disclaimer: CRONOBIOMA helps you get to know your habits: it is not a medical device and does not replace your doctor’s advice. Times are approximate.
cronobioma.doctorNote: If you have been sleeping badly for more than three weeks, snore loudly with pauses in your breathing or feel sleepy during the day, even while driving, talk to your doctor.
cronobioma.metaDescription: The free test on your internal clock: find out if you are a lark or an owl, your social jet lag and your ideal day.
cronobioma.publicTitle: Lark or owl? Discover your internal clock.
cronobioma.publicText: Eight questions about your real schedule. Discover your chronotype, what the weekend costs you and your ideal day.

cronobioma.typeText_lark: Your clock runs early: you wake up early and full of energy, you are at your best in the morning and you switch off early in the evening.
cronobioma.typeText_early: You are a morning person: you get up without much effort and your energy drops already in the early evening.
cronobioma.typeText_intermediate: Your clock is average: you adapt well to everyone’s schedule, with an energy peak in the middle of the day.
cronobioma.typeText_late: Your clock runs a little late: mornings are slow, but from the afternoon on you are at your best.
cronobioma.typeText_owl: Your clock runs late: getting up early is hard, while in the evening and at night you are sharp and creative.
cronobioma.jetlag_low: Your clock stays almost the same all week: great.
cronobioma.jetlag_mid: Between work days and free days you shift by {time}: every Monday is like coming back from a trip with a time difference of an hour or two.
cronobioma.jetlag_high: Between work days and free days you shift by {time}: every Monday is like coming back from an intercontinental trip. That is what makes Mondays so hard.
cronobioma.unreliable: With an alarm on free days or with shifts the result is less precise: in the full service you will find the plan made for shifts.
cronobioma.evText_light: 15–30 minutes outdoors or near a window: it is the strongest signal to set your clock.
cronobioma.evText_focus: Your mind is sharper: keep the work that needs attention for this time.
cronobioma.evText_dip: It is normal to feel slower: a walk or a 20-minute nap helps.
cronobioma.evText_movement: Muscles, coordination and heart perform at their best.
cronobioma.evText_caffeine: Caffeine stays in your body for many hours: after this time it can ruin your sleep.
cronobioma.evText_dinner: Eat by this time so you digest before sleeping.
cronobioma.evText_screens: Low lights and no phone: the light from screens delays sleep.
cronobioma.evText_melatonin: Your body starts getting ready for sleep, following your natural clock.
cronobioma.evText_bed: To sleep {hours} and wake up at {wake}.
cronobioma.evText_tempLow: Your body temperature is at its lowest and sleep is deepest.
cronobioma.previewMore: In the full clock you will also find focus, physical activity, dinner, screens and melatonin, the sleep diary, calendar reminders and plans for shifts and travel.
cronobioma.earlyNote: You get up {time} before your natural clock. Move it earlier little by little, 15 minutes every 3–4 days, and get light as soon as you wake up.

cronobioma.tip_weekend: At the weekend you shift a lot: try not to get up more than an hour later than usual.

cronobioma.tip_keepGoing: Very regular times: your clock thanks you.

cronobioma.shiftNightNote: Night shift: your clock would like to sleep while you work. This plan reduces tiredness and protects your sleep the next day.
cronobioma.stText_sleepBefore: Go to bed early so you sleep at least 7 hours before your shift.
cronobioma.stText_nap: A nap before the night shift reduces tiredness.
cronobioma.stText_lightStart: Turn on all the lights or stay in the light: it keeps you awake and alert.
cronobioma.stText_caffeineStop: After this time coffee will ruin your sleep after the shift.
cronobioma.stText_meal: Better light: at night and during the shift digestion is slower.
cronobioma.stText_sunglasses: On the way home avoid bright morning light: it helps you fall asleep.
cronobioma.stText_sleepAfter: Right away, in the dark and cool, with your phone on silent.
cronobioma.stText_anchor: A little light when you wake up brings you back to the rhythm of the day.

cronobioma.travel_east: Going east: your clock needs to move forward. Light in the morning, no bright light in the evening.

textShield.heroText: Names, tax codes, IBANs, phone numbers and addresses become neutral labels like [PERSON 1]. Give the text to ChatGPT or Gemini, then paste the answer here: the real data goes back in place.
textShield.privacyNote: The text stays on this device: KUMANI analyses it in the browser and sends it to no one, not even its own servers.
textShield.step1Text: Paste the text or upload a file: minutes, report, email, contract…
textShield.formats: Accepted files: PDF with text, Word (.docx), TXT. Photos and scanned PDFs can't be read: for photos of documents use Documento Sicuro.

fileError.empty: There's no readable text in the file (maybe it's a scan): for photos of documents use Documento Sicuro.
fileError.tooBig: The file is too big (max 15 MB).

textShield.step2Text: Highlighted data will be replaced. Tap an item to leave it visible (or hide it again); tap a type to exclude all of it.

textShield.copyError: Couldn't copy: select the text and copy it manually.
textShield.reviewNote: Always reread the text before sharing it: automatic detection helps a lot but is not infallible, especially with rare names or data described in words.
textShield.step4Title: 4. Put the data back into the AI's answer
textShield.step4Text: Paste the AI's answer: labels like [PERSON 1] turn back into the real names and data, only here on your device.
textShield.noSessions: The “key” of the text you protect will appear here as soon as you copy or download it. It stays only in this browser for 7 days.

fototessera.heroTitle: The right ID photo, no photo booth
fototessera.heroText: Take or pick a photo: KUMANI finds the face, straightens it, adds a white background and sets the head to the required size. Download the photo for online portals or a 10×15 sheet with 6 photos to print.
fototessera.validFor: 35×45 mm format: identity card, passport, driving licence and residence permit.
fototessera.privacyNote: The photo stays on this device: KUMANI processes it in the browser and never uploads it.
fototessera.tipsTitle: For a photo that passes the check
fototessera.tip1: Have someone else take the photo, about 1.5 metres away, with the phone at eye level.
fototessera.tip2: Use a white or very light, plain background (a wall or a white sheet), half a metre behind your shoulders: the edges of head and hair come out much cleaner. Light in front of you, no shadows on the face.
fototessera.tip3: Look straight at the phone, mouth closed, neutral expression, eyes open.
fototessera.tip4: No hats, sunglasses or hair over the eyes. Glasses are fine if they don’t reflect.
fototessera.tip5: Include your shoulders: KUMANI takes care of the rest.
fototessera.loading: Getting face detection ready… (the first time it downloads about 40 MB)
fototessera.errLoad: Face detection didn’t load. Check your connection and try again.
fototessera.errRead: The photo can’t be opened. Try another one.
fototessera.errNoFace: We can’t find a face. Use a well-lit, front-facing photo showing the whole face.
fototessera.errManyFaces: There is more than one person in the photo: use a photo of one person only.
fototessera.checkOk: Face centred, head between 32 and 36 mm.
fototessera.warn_blur: The face is small in the photo: the print may not be sharp. Move closer or use the back camera.
fototessera.warn_dark: The photo is dark: find more light.
fototessera.warn_bright: The photo is too bright: avoid direct sunlight.
fototessera.warn_shadow: One side of the face is in shadow: you need even light.
fototessera.warn_turned: The face seems turned: look straight at the phone.
fototessera.warn_mouth: The mouth seems open: documents need a closed mouth.
fototessera.warn_edges: The photo doesn’t reach the edges: take it again from a little further away.
fototessera.warn_noMask: We can’t separate the background: use a light, plain wall.
fototessera.disclaimer: This check is a guide only: the office issuing the document has the final say.
fototessera.sheetHint: Print the sheet at 10×15 cm (4×6 in) without borders, at a photo shop or kiosk, and cut along the grey lines.
fototessera.warn_background: The background is dark or colourful: with a white or light wall the hair edges come out cleaner.
fototessera.smartHint: The camera checks distance, position, straight head, open eyes and light live, then takes the photo by itself when everything is right.
fototessera.liveDenied: Camera permission denied. Allow it in your browser settings, or untick “Guided shot”.
fototessera.liveError: The camera isn’t available. Untick “Guided shot” and use your phone’s camera.
fototessera.live_noFace: Put your face inside the oval
fototessera.live_many: Only one person can be in the photo
fototessera.live_center: Centre your face in the oval
fototessera.live_chin: Keep your chin level, not up or down
fototessera.live_bright: Too much light: move out of direct light
fototessera.live_shadow: There’s a shadow on one side: face the light
